games.name: Arrow To Rich
games.description:
Arrow To Rich is a serene minimalist puzzle game that challenges you to remove arrows from a grid in the perfect sequence without any collisions. With clean visuals and pure logic, it offers a calm yet deeply satisfying brain workout for players who enjoy strategic thinking.
Core Gameplay
Each level presents a grid filled with arrows pointing in different directions. Your task is simple but elegant: tap an arrow to slide it out along its path — but only if the entire route is clear. One wrong order and a path becomes blocked. You must carefully plan ahead, visualize movements, and find the exact sequence that empties the board safely.
As you progress, puzzles grow more complex with tighter clusters and overlapping paths, training your spatial reasoning and foresight. There are no timers, no lives, and no pressure — just peaceful, rewarding logic.
Key Features

Hundreds of handcrafted levels with smoothly increasing difficulty
Beautiful minimalist design with soft colors and clean interface
Unlimited retries and pause anytime for stress-free play
Smart hint system to gently guide you when stuck
Offline mode, perfect for travel or quiet moments
Satisfying “perfect clear” achievements for mastering levels without mistakes

Who Is It For?
Arrow To Rich is ideal for fans of Flow Free, sliding block puzzles, or any game that rewards patience and pattern recognition. Whether you’re a student sharpening focus, a professional needing a mental break, or a casual player seeking relaxing “aha!” moments, this game delivers quiet satisfaction.
No flashy stories or distractions — just pure puzzle joy. Every cleared grid brings a peaceful sense of accomplishment as the last arrow slides away, leaving a perfectly empty board.
Start with simple levels to learn the flow, then tackle advanced grids that demand deeper planning. With practice, you’ll spot elegant solutions faster and feel your logical skills improve.
Arrow To Rich proves that great puzzles don’t need complexity — just clever design and your own thoughtful mind. Ready to turn arrows into rich logical victories? Download and begin your calm journey today. Remove arrows from the grid in the right order without collisions

games.description:
Game Overview
This is a classic 4x4 jigsaw puzzle game with 16 scattered pieces split from a complete beauty-themed image. Players drag and swap pieces to restore the full picture, and must finish the puzzle before the countdown ends to clear the level. Any piece placed in the correct position will automatically lock into place and cannot be moved again, making the puzzle process both stress-relieving and engaging.

---
Basic Game Rules
Piece Swap Mechanics
- At the start of each round, the 16 puzzle pieces are randomly shuffled and fill the entire 4x4 grid layout, with each piece being an equal cut of the original complete image.
- Press and hold any puzzle piece, drag it to the position of another target piece, then release your finger to swap the two pieces.
- There are no limits on swap direction or distance; you can adjust pieces repeatedly until they are in the right position.
Auto-Lock Mechanism
Once a puzzle piece is moved to its exact correct position matching the original image, the system will automatically trigger the lock effect. The piece will be fixed in the grid and disabled from further dragging or swapping, with a clear visual indicator to separate completed areas from unadjusted pieces.

---
Level Clear Rules
Core Clear Condition: Restore all 16 puzzle pieces to their correct positions to form a complete, seamless beauty image before the countdown timer at the top of the screen expires.
- If the puzzle is not fully completed when the countdown ends, the round is deemed failed, and you can choose to restart the current level.
- When restarting a failed round, all previously locked pieces will be reset, and the 16 pieces will be randomly shuffled again for a new attempt.

---
Pro Tips for Faster Clearing
- Prioritize edge and corner pieces first: The corner and outer edge pieces of the 4x4 grid have distinctive features, and locking these pieces first helps build the puzzle framework quickly.
- Focus on detailed clues: Use unique details such as facial features, hairstyle, and clothing patterns from the beauty image to match adjacent piece connections accurately.
- Use the auto-lock feedback wisely: Once a piece is locked, no further adjustments are needed, so focus only on the remaining misplaced pieces to reduce mistakes and save time. Drag 16 puzzle pieces, beat countdown to finish the 4×4 locked beauty jigsaw

DIALED: THE ULTIMATE COLOR PRECISION CHALLENGE

STOP LOOKING. START DIALING.

Do you have a designer’s eye? Can you distinguish between Teal and Turquoise, or Crimson and Scarlet at a glance? Welcome to Dialed, the most addictive and visually stunning color-matching game on iOS. 

Most people see a sunset; you see a gradient. Most people see a forest; you see a palette. Dialed takes that visual intuition and turns it into a high-stakes, precision-based puzzle experience that is as relaxing as it is challenging.

THE CONCEPT
The premise is deceptively simple: We show you a target color. Your job is to find it. 

Using an intuitive, haptic-enhanced digital dial, you must navigate the entire visible spectrum to locate the exact hue, saturation, and brightness of the target. It starts easy—finding a bright red in a sea of yellow—but quickly evolves into a sophisticated test of your neural processing. 

When the difference between winning and losing is a 0.5% shift in hue, do you have the focus to stay Dialed in?

WHY YOU WILL LOVE DIALED

1. Precision Haptic Interface
We’ve engineered Dialed specifically for the iPhone. Feel every click of the color wheel with advanced haptic feedback that makes the digital dial feel like a high-end camera lens. It’s a tactile experience that connects your sense of touch with your sense of sight.

2. Multiple Game Modes
Zen Mode: No timers, no pressure. Just you and the colors. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or practicing your color theory.
Time Attack: How many colors can you match in 60 seconds? Speed meets accuracy in this high-octane mode.
The Gauntlet: One mistake and you are out. How long of a streak can you maintain as the colors get closer and closer together?
Daily Hue: Join the global community in matching the Color of the Day. Compare your accuracy score with players worldwide.

3. Deep Analytics
Ever wondered if you struggle more with greens than blues? Dialed tracks your Color IQ over time. View detailed metrics of your accuracy across the spectrum and watch your perception improve the more you play.

4. Minimalist Aesthetic
No cluttered menus. No intrusive ads. Dialed is built with a Design-First philosophy. It features a clean, OLED-optimized interface that lets the colors take center stage.

A TOOL FOR CREATIVES
While Dialed is a game, it is also a workout for your brain. It is the perfect companion for:
Graphic Designers and Illustrators: Sharpen your ability to identify HEX and RGB values on the fly.
Photographers: Improve your eye for color grading and white balance.
Artists: Master the relationship between complementary and analogous colors.
Gamers: Anyone who loves easy to learn, impossible to master mechanics.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE
Infinite Palette: Millions of possible color combinations ensure no two rounds are ever the same.
Sleek UI: Smooth animations and a minimalist layout that feels right at home on iOS.
Global Leaderboards: Compete for the title of Master of the Spectrum.
Unlockable Themes: Customize your dial and interface as you level up.
Accessibility First: Includes specialized modes for various types of color blindness, ensuring everyone can experience the joy of the hunt.

WHAT THE WORLD IS SAYING
The most satisfying haptic experience I have had on an iPhone. It is like a fidget spinner for your eyes. — AppReview Daily
As a professional painter, I thought this would be easy. I was wrong. Dialed is my new obsession. — User Feedback

ARE YOU READY?
Your eyes are capable of seeing millions of colors, but your brain often takes shortcuts. Dialed forces you to slow down, look closer, and truly see. Whether you are looking to kill five minutes in line or spend an hour mastering the art of the hue, Dialed provides a premium, polished experience that is impossible to put down.

Download Dialed today and see if you have the vision to reach 100% accuracy. How sharp are your eyes? Train your brain to see the world in high definition in Dialed.gg! How sharp are your eyes?

games.name: Layer Tower
games.description:
I. Core Game Objective
Control the size of building floors with one finger, stack floors with precision to build a skyscraper, challenge your highest floor count and all-time best score, and create your very own city skyline.
II. Basic Controls
All actions can be completed with just one finger on the screen:
Press and hold the screen, and the current pending floor will expand evenly outwards at a constant speed.
Release your finger, and the floor will immediately stop expanding, lock in its current size, and fall vertically to complete a stacking action.
III. Core Game Rules
Foundation BoundaryAt the start of each round, there is a fixed foundation with a standard size, which serves as the maximum allowable boundary for all floors. The final size of any floor must not exceed the scope of the foundation.
Valid StackingWhen the locked size of the released floor is fully within the foundation dimensions, the floor will land securely on the structure below. You will successfully stack 1 floor, your floor count increases by 1, and the game automatically progresses to the next round of floor generation and resizing.
Invalid Placement PenaltyWhen the locked size of the floor exceeds the foundation boundary, the portion that extends beyond the foundation will break off and collapse immediately, while 1 health point will be deducted. The remaining valid portion that fits within the boundary will fall to become the new stackable floor, and the game continues to the next round.
Health SystemYou start each round with 3 default health points. 1 point is deducted for each invalid placement, and there is no way to restore lost health points.
IV. Game Over Conditions
The round ends immediately when either of the following conditions is met:
Your health points are reduced to 0.
After falling, the floor makes no valid contact with the already stacked structure below (completely suspended), which is judged as a stacking failure. Tap to scale floor build tower

Color Sort Solitaire is a clean and engaging card game experience that combines color logic, visual sorting, and card-based strategy into a relaxing yet thoughtful puzzle. Each level presents a structured board filled with cards that may show numbers, letters, shapes, or objects. While their symbols vary — echoing the variety found in word puzzle and association-based games — every card follows one simple rule: color defines belonging.

Your task is to activate a color category and carefully guide each card to where it belongs. While the symbols on the cards may change, their visual identity remains the same. Mastery comes from observing the board, spotting connections, understanding how elements are associated, and thinking several moves ahead.

The challenge grows from observation and foresight rather than memorization, offering a challenging yet rewarding experience inspired by the calm focus of a solstice moment.

- Correctly group all cards under their matching color categories
- Use your available moves efficiently and strategically

When the game ends?
- No valid color moves remain
- All moves are used before the board is cleared

Color Sort Solitaire is ideal for players looking for a calm but mentally engaging experience that blends visual logic with strategic thinking. Play at your own pace, enjoy the clarity of visual rules, and relax with a puzzle that stays thoughtful without becoming overwhelming. Fully playable offline, it’s a perfect choice for those moments when you want to focus — anywhere, anytime.

games.name: Arrow Rush 3D
games.description:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲 Click the arrows to make them leave the cube.

If equal: The aircraft takes off smoothly, and the next level unlocks.​

Build your style, upgrade your look, and make every reality shift feel different.

EXPLORE WORLDS AND LEVELS

Some levels test perfect landings. Some reward fast drops. Some push you to use the reality switch at the right moment. Others challenge you to survive longer, collect more, or master combos under pressure.

games.name: Pyramid Orb Matrix
games.description:
Pyramid Orb Matrix is built around neat colored lines that gradually fill the entire playing field. The player connects dots of the same color by drawing paths between them, trying to avoid intersections. At first, the task seems simple: find a pair and connect them with a line. But very quickly, the free space becomes smaller, and each new line begins to influence all the others.

In Pyramid Orb Matrix, it's important to think through your actions in advance. If you draw a path too early or occupy an inconvenient space, you can accidentally block the opportunity for another color. Therefore, the game gradually turns into a calm puzzle that tests your attention and spatial thinking. You need to see the entire board and find a solution that ensures each line occupies its proper place.

A unique feature of Pyramid Orb Matrix is the automatically generated maps. Each new attempt offers a different arrangement of dots and changes the usual solution process. Sometimes the right path is immediately apparent, while other times you have to mentally rebuild the entire board to fill every cell without errors. It's at these moments that it's especially rewarding to see how the chaotic space gradually becomes a complete pattern.

Pyramid Orb Matrix feels like a logic game with clear and understandable rules. Pyramid Orb Matrix doesn't overload you with unnecessary mechanics and focuses on lines, colors, and open spaces. Pyramid Orb Matrix leaves you wanting to play another map, find a neater solution, and completely fill the board without a single intersection. Connect dots with colored paths without crossing.

Solitaire Dream is easy to learn with simple rules:

Objective – Move all 52 cards (hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs) to the four Foundation piles.

🎯 Tips for Success

Practice your power control – a gentle drag is sometimes better than a full swing.

Use the Zoom Ball for tricky putts where missing by a tiny margin means disaster.

Save your Super Ball for holes where you need to jump over obstacles or cover long distances.

Explore every corner of the level to find hidden collectibles – they often require creative shot angles.

Welcome to Park The Car, the most unique and brain-teasing puzzle game you'll play today! This isn't your ordinary parking simulator. It's a thrilling blend of match-3 puzzle mechanics and strategic parking lot mayhem. Get ready to sort, match, and drive your way to victory!

In Park The Car, your mission is to clear a chaotic parking lot filled with colorful vehicles. But you can't just move them anywhere. You must strategically select cars that have a clear path to drive out of the main lot and into the upper parking area. If a vehicle is blocked by another car or object when it tries to accelerate, it will crash in a puff of brown smoke, and you'll have to restart the level!

The twist? The upper parking area has only five limited spaces. Your goal is to direct matching colored cars into these spaces so that three identical vehicles park side by side. Once you successfully match three, they disappear, freeing up space and allowing you to continue clearing the main lot below.

It's a delicate balancing act of logic, timing, and strategy. Do you have what it takes to manage the traffic, avoid crashes, and complete the match-3 challenge?

How to Play:

Survey the main parking lot and identify vehicles of matching colors.

Check each vehicle's path carefully. Select only cars that are unblocked and can accelerate safely out of the lot.

Tap or click a vehicle to make it drive away, off the screen, and into the leftmost open space in the upper parking area.

Your goal is to fill the upper spaces with three cars of the same color lined up side by side.

Successfully match three to clear them from the board and make room for more cars.

If your upper parking fills up with no possible matches, all vehicles will lose their colors, and the game is lost.

Clear all vehicles from the main lot to win the level!

Game Features:

A unique hybrid of parking puzzles and match-3 gameplay

Challenging levels with various parking lot emergency scenarios

Simple one-tap controls: just click or tap a car to move it

Strategic depth: plan your moves to avoid crashes and maximize matches

Limited upper parking spaces add tension and excitement

Fun, colorful visuals and satisfying crash physics

Can you master the traffic and become the ultimate parking puzzle champion?

🚗 Download Park The Car now and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test! A unique match-3 parking puzzle. Clear the lot, match colors, avoid crashes!

If things get tight, you’ve got a few tricks to help out. You can shuffle, undo, or get a hint when your brain just refuses to cooperate. Use them smart, because later levels won’t go easy on you.

Whether you’re killing time, trying to focus, or just want something relaxing that still keeps your brain awake, this one does the job.

Pick things up. Match three. Don’t run out of space.

Sounds easy. It’s not. Clear the mess, match 3, and chill. Way more addictive than it looks.

Enjoy real-time chat during your Mancala games. Talk to friends in private matches or interact with opponents while playing live.


📝 THE RULES OF MANCALA
Mancala (Kalaha) is a classic two-player strategy board game played on a board with twelve pockets and two stores. At the start of the game, each pocket contains four stones. Players take turns picking up all stones from one of their pockets and distributing them counter-clockwise, placing one stone in each pocket and their own store while skipping the opponent’s store.

If the last stone lands in your store, you earn an extra turn. If the last stone lands in an empty pocket on your side and the opposite pocket contains stones, you capture those stones and move them to your store. The game ends when one player has no stones left in their pockets or when a player concedes. The player with the most stones in their store wins.

Mancala is known around the world by many different names, including Congklak, Mangala, Sungka, Ô ăn quan, Congkak, Igisoro, Kalaha, Oware (Awale), Pallanguli, Dakon, Bao, Bohnenspiel and more.

However, he learns fast and creates increasingly complex formulas to fix the consequences of his errors. By revealing puzzle clues and following a progress map, you will guide him from a novice apprentice all the way to a Master of the Arcane Academy!

Just don't be surprised if he gets distracted playing with balls of yarn, hunting mice, or simply taking a nap in a cozy corner.

THE MAGIC OF COLORS
In Wizard Water Sort, every color represents a powerful magical essence. Sorting these potions casts restorative spells across the campus:
Water: Restores and turns on the gorgeous garden fountains.
Fire: Ignites the stoves in the student dining hall kitchens.
Swamp Moss: Makes the magical greenhouse plants bloom beautifully.
Sacred Wind: Spins the weather vane and fully recovers the castle tower.
Sands of Time: Rebuilds the portal room, opening doors to different worlds and eras!

HOW TO PLAY & POWER-UPS
Tap and Pour: Tap a magical vial to pick it up, then tap another to pour the liquid.
Match the Magic: You can only pour a potion if it matches the top color of the destination flask, and there must be enough space.

Extra Flask: Add an empty tube to your board to make sorting easier and avoid dead ends.

games.name: Arrow Rush 3D
games.description:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲 Click the arrows to make them leave the cube.

When a sensor is activated, the task is solved, and the counter for completed puzzles increases. At this moment, a pleasant feeling of order emerges, as if a complex scheme has finally become clear.

The main tension in Luminex Shift is the time limit. You must not only come up with a solution, but also complete it before the countdown ends. If you run out of time, the attempt ends, so the game requires calm but quick thinking. The further you progress, the more you want to solve problems more accurately and confidently.

games.name: Pattern Flick
games.publisher: Jiujiang Xingyuan Engineering Service Co., Ltd.
games.description:
Put your memory to the test with Pattern Flick, a delightful and engaging game that challenges you to recall and recreate flashing patterns on a colorful grid. Designed for players of all ages, Pattern Flick combines simple, intuitive gameplay with a charming sticker-book visual style that brings a smile to your face with every round.

How to play: Watch carefully as a sequence of tiles lights up on the grid. Your goal is to remember the exact pattern and then flick or tap the tiles in the same order. Start with easy, short patterns and gradually progress to longer, more complex sequences as your memory sharpens. The difficulty scales smoothly from simple to medium, making it perfect for quick brain training sessions or longer, more focused play.

Pattern Flick stands out with its whimsical, hand-drawn sticker aesthetic. Each tile features a cute, playful icon—like a smiling star, a friendly animal, or a colorful shape—adding a layer of visual fun to the memory challenge. The cheerful animations and soft sound effects create a relaxing yet stimulating atmosphere that keeps you coming back for more.

Key features include:
- Progressive difficulty: Start with easy patterns and advance to challenging sequences that test your short-term memory limits.
- Adorable sticker art: Enjoy a visually pleasing, kid-friendly design that feels like a scrapbook come to life.
- Simple one-tap controls: Just tap or flick the tiles in the correct order—no complicated gestures required.
- No time pressure: Play at your own pace, perfect for casual gamers and memory enthusiasts alike.
- Endless replayability: Every game generates a new random pattern, so no two rounds are ever the same.

Whether you’re looking to improve your concentration, pass the time on a commute, or enjoy a lighthearted brain workout, Pattern Flick offers endless fun for everyone. Download now and see how many patterns you can remember!

games.name: LinkDrops
games.description:
I. Core Basic Operations
- Swap Tiles: Tap and swipe two adjacent colored tiles to switch their positions. The controls are simple and intuitive, allowing for smooth one-handed gameplay.
- Match Rule: Line up 3 or more identical colored tiles in a straight row (horizontal or vertical) to trigger a blast effect. The matched tiles will be cleared automatically, and points will be awarded accordingly.
- Tile Refill: New tiles will drop from the top to fill the empty spaces left by cleared tiles, creating chances for chain reactions and delivering a satisfying combo experience.
II. Advanced Scoring Tips
Unlike basic match 3 games, this title features advanced match combinations that unleash powerful boosters to help you beat tough levels with ease:
- 4-Match Booster: Match 4 identical tiles to generate a Line Blast Booster, which clears an entire row or column in one click for efficient obstacle removal.
- L/T-Shaped 5-Match Booster: Align 5 identical tiles in an L or T shape to unlock a Area Blast Booster, wiping out a large cluster of surrounding tiles — perfect for breaking dense barriers.
- Straight 5-Match Booster: Line up 5 identical tiles in a straight row to earn a Color Bomb Booster, which matches any color and triggers a wide-range full-screen clear.
- Booster Combo: Swap two different special boosters next to each other to activate a Mega Blast, delivering a massive screen-clearing effect to conquer hard levels quickly. Swap tiles match 3 plus colors blast boosters and solve fun puzzles

Designed for both relaxation and focus, Zen Arrow Flow removes pressure with its no-timer gameplay. Whether you have a few minutes or want to fully immerse yourself, the experience adapts to your pace. Smooth animations, subtle feedback, and a distraction-free interface help you stay in a steady, satisfying flow.

If you ever get stuck, helpful hints are available to guide you forward without breaking the rhythm. Each completed level offers a small sense of accomplishment—a quiet reset for your mind.

With hundreds of handcrafted levels and increasing challenges, Zen Arrow Flow is the perfect balance of strategy and calm. Untangle the arrows, clear the path, and find your flow. Escape Puzzle Games

games.name: Mzansi Charades: Guess & Win!
games.description:
Mzansi Charades — the only party game that actually gets us.
The other charades apps give you words like "skiing" and "Beyoncé" — and nobody's acting that out at a Heritage Day braai. Mzansi Charades is built for South Africans, with hundreds of words and references that only we know. From boerewors to Kabza, Uzalo to the Soweto Derby, "eish" to "ayoba" — every card lands.
How do you play?
One person puts the phone on their forehead without looking. The rest of the players see the word and act it out, sing it, or describe it — but they can't say it. Tilt the phone down when you guess right, up to skip. How many can you get before time runs out?
Sharp, simple, and so addictive you'll forget about load shedding.
Perfect for:
Saturday braais, Sunday lunch with the family, Heritage Day, Detty December at the coast, year-end functions, varsity res, road trips down the Garden Route, long nights in Maboneng, family reunions, matric rage, or any moment when you and your people are trying to laugh until your stomach hurts.
Decks made for Mzansi 
• Mzansi Celebs — From Trevor Noah to Tyla, Bonang to Somizi, Mihlali to Lasizwe and every face you've grown up with
• Music — Amapiano, gqom, kwaito, hip-hop, Afro-pop. Kabza De Small, Uncle Waffles, Cassper Nyovest, Nasty C, the late AKA, Black Coffee, Brenda Fassie and the whole Mzansi sound
• Soapies & TV — Uzalo, Generations, Skeem Saam, Scandal!, House of Zwide, Shaka iLembe, The Wife, Big Brother Mzansi and every show your gogo won't miss
• YouTubers & Podcasters — MacG, Mihlali, Lasizwe, Sizwe Dhlomo, Pap Culture and the voices that run SA timelines
• Sport Stars — Siya Kolisi, Cheslin Kolbe, Kagiso Rabada, Temba Bavuma, Itumeleng Khune, Hugo Sánchez of Mzansi soccer and the heroes of every code
• PSL & Soweto Derby — Chiefs, Pirates, Sundowns, the Boks, Bafana, Banyana, FNB Stadium, Loftus, Moses Mabhida and every vuvuzela moment that matters
• SA Brands — Shoprite to Woolies, Nando's to KFC, Castle Lite to Savanna, Simba to Romany Creams. The shelves of every Mzansi home
• Mzansi Food — Boerewors, pap, kota, bunny chow, gatsby, vetkoek, chakalaka, biltong, malva pudding, peri-peri chicken and the full Sunday seven colours
• Joburg & Beyond — Sandton, Soweto, Vilakazi Street, Maboneng, Cape Town, Durban, Umhlanga, Garden Route and the corners that make us
• Mzansi Slang — Lekker, eish, sharp, ayoba, howzit, jol, kasi, mfowethu, sho-sho and the words we drop in every other sentence
• Memes & Moments — Load shedding stages, Jerusalema challenge, Tshwala Bam, MaMkhize moments, Tito Mboweni cooking, John Cena Sho Madjozi and the viral history of SA Twitter
• Quintessentially Mzansi — December at the coast, Stage 6, the Sunday roast, lobola negotiations, Streetwise Two, Stokvel payouts, Heritage Day braais and the everyday rituals only we get
Why Mzansi Charades?
Because the other apps were built somewhere else, by people who don't know what a kota is. We do. Every word, every reference, every laugh is by Mzansi, for Mzansi.

• Hundreds of authentically South African words and phrases

Don't Touch the Bomb - Both players secretly hide bombs on a grid. Don't hit a bomb or you lose a life.

Guess the Number - Lock in a secret number between 1 and 1000. Higher or Lower hints.

Guess the Word - One player picks a secret word. The other guesses with colour tile feedback.

Stop the Clock - Both players count silently and tap when they think the target time is up.

Spin the Wheel - Add up to 20 names and spin. Whoever the arrow lands on loses.

Pick the Biggest Fish - Pick mystery fish with hidden sizes. Dramatic one-by-one reveal at the end.

Heads or Tails - Tap the coin. That is it.

Impossible Card Game - Four predictions. Almost nobody wins.

Guess the Code - Crack a secret number code in 8 guesses.

No internet needed. No accounts. Free to download.

Game Core

At the start, only colored ports appear on the map with no pre-built pipes.You must draw paths manually to connect matching-color ports and pair all ports to clear the level.
Core Rules
Connection RuleOnly two ports of the same color can be connected. Ports of different colors cannot be linked.Each color has exactly one pair of ports. You must create a pipe path for each matching pair.
Pipe PlacementYou control pipe placement manually. Pipes can run straight or turn along the grid, allowing free route planning.Pipes must form a single, continuous, unbroken path to fully connect the two ports of the same color.

Puan ve Altın Ödülleri: Bulduğunuz her kelime size puan ve oyun içi altın kazandırır.

Günlük Giriş Bonusları: Her gün oyuna girerek sürpriz hediyeler ve büyük altın ödülleri toplayın.

Başarımlar: Kelime dağarcığınızı geliştirirken özel başarımların kilidini açın ve koleksiyonunuzu tamamlayın.

Benzersiz Etap Tasarımı: Her bir etap, Türkiye'nin tarihi, doğal ve kültürel açıdan önemli bir noktasına adanmıştır.

Keşif Kartları: Etapları tamamladıkça o bölgeye ait özel Keşif Kartları kazanırsınız. Bu kartlar, o yerin tarihi, önemi ve gezilmesi gerekenler hakkında kısa ve ilginç bilgiler içerir.

Örnek: Kapadokya'nın balonları, Pamukkale'nin travertenleri, Efes Antik Kenti'nin ihtişamı...

İlham Veren Görseller: Her seviyenin arka planı, keşfettiğiniz bölgenin nefes kesen, yüksek çözünürlüklü görselleriyle zenginleştirilmiştir. Bulmaca çözerken adeta o atmosferin içine girersiniz!

Kelime Ustası'nın Temel Özellikleri
Binlerce Seviye: Kolaydan zora doğru ilerleyen, sürekli güncellenen ve zorluk seviyesi artan binlerce kelime bulmacası. Asla sıkılmayacaksınız!

Zengin Kelime Dağarcığı: Güncel ve geniş bir kelime havuzu. Oynarken kelime bilginizi fark etmeden geliştireceksiniz.

Yardımcı İpuçları: Takıldığınızda kullanabileceğiniz ipuçları (bir harfi açığa çıkarma veya tüm kelimeyi gösterme) ile asla çaresiz kalmazsınız.

Zaman Kısıtlaması Yok: Kendi hızınızda, stressiz bir şekilde oynayın. İster sabah kahvenizin yanında, ister yolda, ister yatmadan önce keyfini çıkarın.

Çevrimdışı Oynama: İnternet bağlantısına ihtiyacınız olmadan dilediğiniz yerde ve zamanda oyunu oynayabilirsiniz.
Neden Kelime Ustası Oynamalısınız?
Kelime Ustası sadece bir oyun değil, aynı zamanda:

Beyin Egzersizi: Hafızanızı güçlendirir, odaklanma yeteneğinizi artırır ve hızlı düşünme becerilerinizi geliştirir.

Kelime Gelişimi: Bilmediğiniz kelimeleri öğrenmenize ve aktif kelime dağarcığınızı genişletmenize yardımcı olur.

Kültürel Farkındalık: Türkiye'nin tarihi ve doğal güzellikleri hakkında ilginç bilgiler edinmenizi sağlar. Belki de bir sonraki tatil rotanızı Kelime Ustası belirler!

Rahatlatıcı Deneyim: Sakinleştirici fon müzikleri ve görselleri sayesinde günlük stresinizden uzaklaşmanızı sağlar.

Haydi, harfleri birleştirin, kelimeleri çözün ve Türkiye'nin gizemlerini açığa çıkarın!

Dial Tone is a rhythm game where you make the music.

Three concentric rings glow on a dark screen, divided into quarter notes, eighth notes, and sixteenth notes. Lasers fire in from the corners, placing colored blocks onto the rings. A beat hand sweeps like a clock, and every block it passes plays a note. Your job: rotate the rings and fill one completely to clear it.

But here‘s the catch. As outer rings fill up, they become obstacles. A laser that collides with the wrong ring ends the game. The fuller the rings get, the more you‘re juggling, and the more complex the music becomes.

There are no points. Your score is the tempo. You start slow, and every time you clear a ring, the BPM ticks up. How fast can you go?

The music is yours. No two sessions sound the same. Every block you place adds notes to a chord. The result is a polyrhythmic, ever-changing composition that you‘re building as you play. A song that no one has heard before and no one will hear again.

WHAT MAKES DIAL TONE DIFFERENT

Unlike traditional rhythm games, you don‘t follow a pre-made song. The music emerges from your gameplay. Every session produces a unique piece shaped by your decisions, your reflexes, and the rising tempo.

The interaction is pure and tactile: spin the rings with your finger like a rotary dial. No tapping to a beat. No memorizing patterns. Just a fluid, physical mechanic that starts meditative and becomes frantic.

DESIGNED WITH CARE

• Dial Tone honors iOS Accessibility settings for color filtering, reduced motion, and sensitivity to flashing lights.
• Tiny download. Everything — visuals, music, and gameplay — is generated in code.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions. No tracking. No internet connection required. Just you and the game. Spin the rings. Build the beat. No two games sound the same. A rhythm game where every session creates its own evolving song. The faster you go, the wilder it gets. The Beat Is Calling

Fortebet feels like a light arcade game that challenges reaction and precision. 🃏 How to Play
The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

games.name: Pirots

Pirots centers around memory, attention, and short rounds where your goal is to accurately replicate a sequence you’ve just seen. At the start of each level, the game displays a set of fruits on the board, giving the player a few seconds to memorize their positions. The images then disappear, and the second phase of the challenge begins: you must tap on all the fruits in the correct sequence, relying solely on your memory and the provided ordering cue.

In Pirots, each round becomes slightly more difficult. Initially, there are only two fruits on the board, making the task seem simple; however, as you progress, the number of items increases, making it harder to retain the entire sequence in your mind. A single mistake—or running out of time before completing your selection—immediately results in having to restart the round. This creates a palpable sense of tension throughout the game: you must observe carefully, memorize quickly, and act without hesitation.

A key feature of Pirots is that its difficulty scales smoothly and gradually. New rounds unlock only after you have successfully cleared the previous ones, giving the player ample time to adapt to the rules and experience a genuine sense of progress. Each successful attempt brings a satisfying feeling of precision—as if a short visual puzzle has just clicked perfectly into place.

Pirots feels like a calm yet demanding game focused on visual memory. It avoids cluttering the experience with unnecessary actions, keeping the spotlight firmly on the core objective: observe, memorize, and replicate the sequence. Pirots leaves you with a desire to tackle the next round with even greater precision—to recall the fruit positions faster and make it all the way to the final challenge without making a single mistake. Memorize the fruits and reveal them in the correct order.

games.name: LastCards
games.description:
LAST CARDS — PREMIUM COMPETITIVE CARD ACTION

Race to empty your hand in a fast, tactical shedding game built for quick rounds and real competition. The same rules power offline play and online servers, so what you practice is what you play.

CORE GAMEPLAY
• Standard 52-card deck plus 2 Jokers (54 cards) — 2 to 7 players, 7 cards each, classic match-suit-or-rank play.
• Can’t play? Draw one — your turn ends (drawn card can’t be played same turn).
• Multi-card turns: drop multiple cards of the same rank, build same-suit runs up or down, then bridge with a cross-suit tie-in — deep combos without losing clarity.

SPECIAL CARDS — TURN THE TABLE
Twos stack draw penalties; Black Jacks pile on; Red Jacks cancel stacks while keeping the “pick-up chain” tense. Kings reverse flow (with smart two-player behavior), Aces change suit, Queens lock suits, Eights skip, and Jokers are full wildcards — with a clear order when effects collide.

LAST CARDS DECLARATION (STANDARD MODES)
When you’re about to go out in one turn, declare “Last Cards” before your turn — miss the call or bluff the table and face penalties. High-skill, high-drama finishes.

MODES FOR EVERY MOOD
• Play with AI — sharpen tactics offline.
• Practice — same as AI; no leaderboard impact.
• Online — Quick Match or Private Game with a room code; casual wins can count on leaderboards when the match is trophy-eligible (not private).
• Ranked — signed-in quick match, MMR, and competitive ladders (60s turns).
• Ranked (Hardcore) — stricter finish rules, 30s turns, separate MMR and leaderboard (e.g., no winning on an Ace; Joker last-card restrictions).
• Tournament — knockout elimination: last to finish each round is out until one champion remains (vs AI or online).
• Bust — large-party elimination mode (up to 10 players): 52-card deck, no Jokers, round structure and placement rules that keep big tables moving; offline and online with dedicated leaderboards.

COMPETE & PROGRESS
Climb mode-specific leaderboards, track ranked performance, and show up signed in for the full competitive experience (anonymous sign-in may be available depending on setup).

POLISH & FAIR PLAY
Clean presentation, responsive pacing, and server-backed online sessions with disconnect handling suited to real multiplayer.

Drop in for a casual hand, grind ranked, or run a tournament — Last Cards is built for players who want skill, speed, and spectacle in every round. LastCards is Fast, competitive card game with combos, strategy, and online play

games.name: Vial Sorter

Step into the shoes of a meticulous alchemist in Vial Sorter, a soothing yet challenging puzzle game that blends classic logic with a charmingly rustic aesthetic. Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into individual vials until each one contains a single, pure hue. But don’t be fooled by the straightforward premise—each level introduces new twists that will test your planning and patience.

Inspired by the timeless bottle-sorting mechanic, Vial Sorter elevates the genre with a lovingly crafted visual style reminiscent of an old-world apothecary. Wooden shelves, amber glass, worn labels, and soft candlelight create an immersive atmosphere that makes every move feel deliberate. The gentle clink of glass and subtle liquid sounds add to the calming experience, perfect for unwinding after a long day.

Gameplay is intuitive: tap a vial to pick up its top layer of liquid, then tap another vial to pour it in. You can only pour a color on top of the same color, and you must leave enough space in the receiving vial. As you progress, you’ll encounter limited empty vials, increased color varieties, and tricky arrangements that demand careful sequencing. With difficulty ranging from easy to medium, Vial Sorter is accessible for beginners but offers plenty of head-scratching moments for seasoned puzzle fans.

Key features include hundreds of handcrafted levels with no time limits—play at your own pace. A generous hint system helps when you get stuck, and an undo button lets you reverse mistakes without penalty. The clean, clutter-free interface ensures you focus on the puzzle, not the buttons. There are no ads during gameplay, and optional rewarded ads offer extra hints or level skips.

Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Vial Sorter fits seamlessly into your day. Its satisfying “aha!” moments and serene presentation make it a perfect companion for commutes, breaks, or quiet evenings. Download now and discover the joy of bringing order to colorful chaos—one pour at a time!

games.name: Mahjong Tiles of Wind
games.description:
Mahjong is a classic tile-based game with a long history and strategic depth based on scoring combinations and layered gameplay. Inspired by this traditional concept, Mahjong Tiles of Wind reimagines its core idea in a modern competitive format built around pattern recognition and finding matching symbols. Each match becomes a tense competition where even seconds matter. The winner is the one who reacts faster and navigates the constantly changing situation more efficiently.

The rules are simple — a target tile materializes in the center of the screen. The current match that needs to be found among your tiles is defined by it. Your goal is to identify and tap the same tile faster than the other players. Once you select the correct tile, it disappears from your hand, bringing you closer to victory. All other players continue with the same set, so each round has the same conditions for everyone but different outcomes depending on reaction speed. There are no turns or waiting in this game — everyone acts at the same time. A round ends when one player clears their entire hand.

The game gives you access to two modes right from the start, letting you choose how you want to play. Training helps you quickly understand the mechanics, while VS AI delivers the main competitive experience against computer opponents. Before each match, you can choose the number of players, which affects the difficulty. The more players, the faster the pace, the denser the flow of actions, and the quicker you need to react to win.

The game keeps you in a constant state of fast focus, where spotting matches and reacting faster than your opponents is essential. This naturally improves your reaction speed and attention. Sound effects, visual feedback, and smooth animations support the experience, making every action feel more responsive and clear. Built-in training helps you quickly grasp the mechanics so you can jump straight into gameplay. Different visual table styles are available as presentation variants that change the visual tone of each match.

All these elements together create a fast, structured, and highly engaging experience. Every round feels like a short but intense competition. Mahjong with a modern twist

games.description: LayerTap presents a vertical stack of coloured layers viewed from the side. Each layer shows a number counting how many taps it takes to break through. Animal Totem Rise is an arcade game focused on balance and precision, where the player constructs a tower out of wild animals in a safari-themed setting. In Animal Totem Rise, each new animal adds a layer of complexity, as every creature possesses a unique size and weight that affects the stability of the structure.

Upon launching Animal Totem Rise for the first time, the Privacy Policy screen is displayed; the player is then directed to a start screen featuring a "Continue" button, followed by the main menu. Here, sections for "Start," "Settings," and "How to Play" are available.

The gameplay in Animal Totem Rise is physics-based. Animals appear from the top of the screen, and the player controls their horizontal positioning by swiping left and right. At the precise moment, the player must release the object to let it drop onto the tower. The more accurate the placement, the more stable the structure becomes.

As the tower grows taller in Animal Totem Rise, maintaining balance becomes increasingly difficult. An uneven placement or an awkward drop can lead to a loss of stability and the collapse of the entire structure, bringing the game to an end.

The "How to Play" section in Animal Totem Rise explains the controls and the fundamental principles of balance. In the settings menu, players can toggle sound effects, music, and vibration on or off.

Animal Totem Rise combines simple mechanics, object physics, and mounting tension, transforming every attempt into a test of precision and patience. Build a tower out of animals and maintain your balance.

Betwinner is a casual chess trivia quiz made for quick play on your phone. Choose a difficulty before each round and answer multiple choice questions about chess rules, pieces, famous players, major tournaments, and chess history. Every tap counts toward your score.

When you open the app you see Easy, Medium, and Hard on the start screen. Each level uses its own question pool. Easy covers how pieces move, board layout, check, checkmate, and simple facts for newcomers. Medium adds tournament hosts, title rules, notable games, and broader culture. Hard brings deep history, world champions, classic matches, federation details, and expert facts.

Each round in Betwinner presents chess questions one at a time with four answer choices. Tap the option you believe is correct. Right answers add to your score and advance the round. Wrong answers reveal the correct choice so you learn before the next card. A progress bar and question counter show how far you are through the set.

A round timer runs for the whole session. Answer as many questions as you can before time runs out. Finish the full set to complete the round with a full summary. If the timer hits zero first, the round ends and your results are saved for that attempt.

During play you track score, remaining time, difficulty level, and current question number. The layout is vertical with large touch friendly buttons and readable question cards.

After the round ends, Betwinner shows a results screen with your final score, personal best, level played, correct answers, questions answered, and whether you finished the set or ran out of time. Tap Play Again to return to the start menu and choose a new level.
Replay one difficulty to improve or switch levels to explore new topics.

Betwinner highlights correct answers in green and wrong ones in red while revealing the right option. Brief pauses between cards keep the flow clear.

The question library covers rules and pieces including movement, captures, castling, and pawn specials. . Notation basics and symbols from published games appear alongside famous players, world titles, and historic championship matches. International events, national championships, and well known tournament cities are included, plus federation facts and team competitions that shape modern competitive chess. Whether you follow live events or study on your own, the quiz blends familiar ideas with details that may be new even to regular players.

Betwinner fits short breaks and longer sessions. Pick a level, read the card, tap an answer, and continue until the round ends. The focus stays on knowledge and steady pacing under the clock.

Tips for stronger runs in Betwinner. Start on Easy while learning piece names and rules. Try Medium for tournament and culture facts. Choose Hard for championship history and advanced trivia. Watch the timer and answer at a steady pace.

Replay to beat your best on each level. Compare Easy and Hard results to see where your knowledge is strongest. Wrong answers act as quick lessons because the right option appears before the next question.

Betwinner is chess trivia in a clean mobile package. Three levels, timed rounds, multiple choice play, score tracking, personal bests, progress feedback, and detailed round results are included. Install Betwinner and test your chess knowledge. Betwinner is a chess trivia quiz with Easy, Medium, and Hard rounds.

games.name: Spot Flash Color
games.description:
Spot Flash Color shows you a sequence and asks one question: what is different?

A row of colored pairs appears on screen. Each position holds two colors stacked vertically — a top and a bottom. You have two seconds to memorize the sequence. Then it vanishes. Then it returns, identical in every way except one position, where something has changed.

Tap the position that changed.

At first the change is obvious. A red pair becomes green. You see it immediately. You tap it. You score. The next sequence is longer. The change is slightly less obvious. You start to look more carefully, building a mental map of the sequence before it disappears.

Then the changes become subtle. Not red to green — red to purple. Two colors that look similar under pressure, similar in memory, different only if you were paying close attention to exactly the right thing. Then the change is not a color at all — a pair that was red on top and blue on bottom is now blue on top and red on bottom. Same colors. Wrong order. You have to remember not just what colors were present but where each one sat.

At high scores the sequence holds twelve pairs. The change is a single step along a color wheel — nearly invisible, detectable only by someone who has trained their color memory to a level most people never reach.

Spot Flash Color is a game about attention. About the quality of the mental photograph you take in the two seconds you are given, and whether that photograph is detailed enough to survive the moment of darkness before the answer is revealed.

No ads. No luck. No timers at first. Just a sequence, a change, and the question of whether you saw it. A sequence of colored pairs flashes on screen. One pair changes. Tap the position that changed. The sequence gets longer. The changes get subtler.

games.name: Match Blend Pigment
games.description:
Match Blend Pigment gives you paint tubes and a target color and asks you to recreate it.

A color swatch sits on the left. Your mixing palette is on the right. Below both: a set of pigment tubes — cadmium red, ultramarine blue, cadmium yellow, titanium white. Drag a tube upward to add more of that pigment to the mix. The swatch on the right updates as you blend. When it looks right, submit.

The mixing behaves like real paint. Red and blue make purple. Red and yellow make orange. All three primaries together make brown. This is subtractive mixing — the way pigments actually work, not the way screens do. Players who have mixed paint before will find their intuition transfers directly. Players who haven't will develop new intuition quickly, because the feedback is immediate and visual and honest.

There are no numbers. No percentage readouts, no color codes, no distance meters. Just two swatches side by side and the gap between them. The game scores you by how close the match is, but it never tells you the score until after you submit. You look, you judge, you commit.

As your score climbs the palette shrinks. White is removed first — you can no longer lighten colors by adding white, which forces darker and more saturated mixes. Then the palette narrows to three primaries, then two. Matching a complex tertiary color using only cadmium yellow and ultramarine blue is a genuinely difficult color reasoning challenge.

At higher scores a slider lock activates. Once you push a pigment past a threshold, it cannot be reduced. You have committed that pigment to the mix — just like real paint, which cannot be unmixed once added.

Match Blend Pigment is a game about color perception. About looking carefully at two swatches and knowing which direction to push the mix. About developing an intuition for how pigments interact that most people have never been asked to cultivate.

No ads. No timers at first. No luck. Just color, paint, and the difference between what you see and what you made. A target color appears. Mix your pigments until the swatches match. The palette shrinks as your score climbs. Trust your eyes — no numbers shown.

🎯 STRATEGIC POWER-UPS

Equip up to 4 power-ups before each run:
• 💣 BOMB — Destroy all visible words at once
• 🔮 X-RAY — Reveal correct order for 2 seconds
• 🛡️ SHIELD — Absorb the next hit
• ❄️ FREEZE — Slow everything down for 5 seconds

Earn more power-ups by clearing milestone words and chaining combos.

🌍 GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS

Compete with players worldwide in both modes. Climb the ranks. Become a legend.

👥 INVITE FRIENDS, GET REWARDS

Share your referral code with up to 5 friends. Every friend who joins gives both of you extra power-ups for free.

🏆 PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY

Starts easy with 3-letter words. Unlocks longer words and DECOY LETTERS as you progress — tap the fake letter first to reveal the real word. Can you spot the trap?

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

• Truly fast-paced — no boring waiting
• Zero pay-to-win — every mechanic is earned through skill
• Sign in with Google, Apple, or Email to sync progress
• Bilingual: English + Spanish (more languages coming)
• Gorgeous sci-fi visuals with smooth 60fps gameplay
• Lightweight — small download, runs on older devices

🎵 IMMERSIVE SOUND

Synthwave soundtrack and laser SFX. Play with headphones for maximum cosmic vibes.

🔐 PRIVACY FIRST

No location tracking. No sketchy data collection. No creepy targeting. See our full privacy policy for details.

📱 PLAY OFFLINE

All core gameplay works offline. Online features (leaderboards, friend invites) require sign-in.

💡 TIPS FOR HIGH SCORES

• Chain combos — x3 combo gives time bonus in Time Attack
• Save bombs for when 3+ words are falling
• Use X-Ray when a hard word is near your ship
• Tap decoy letters FIRST — they reveal the real word

games.name: Win Tactix
games.description:
Win Tactix is ​​a casual chess trivia quiz made for quick play on your phone. Choose a difficulty before each round and answer multiple choice questions about chess rules, pieces, famous players, major tournaments, and chess history. Every tap counts towards your score.

When you open the app you see Easy, Medium, and Hard on the start screen. Each level uses its own question pool. Easy covers how pieces move, board layout, check, checkmate, and simple facts for newcomers. Medium adds tournament hosts, title rules, notable games, and broader culture. Hard brings deep history, world champions, classic matches, federation details, and expert facts.

Each round in Win Tactix presents chess questions one at a time with four answer choices. Tap the option you believe is correct. Right answers add to your score and advance the round. Wrong answers reveal the correct choice so you learn before the next card. A progress bar and question counter show how far you are through the set.

A round timer runs for the entire session. Answer as many questions as you can before time runs out. Finish the full set to complete the round with a full summary. If the timer hits zero first, the round ends and your results are saved for that attempt.

During play you track score, remaining time, difficulty level, and current question number. The layout is vertical with large touch friendly buttons and readable question cards.

After the round ends, Win Tactix shows a results screen with your final score, personal best, level played, correct answers, questions answered, and whether you finished the set or ran out of time. Tap Play Again to return to the start menu and choose a new level.
Replay one difficulty to improve or switch levels to explore new topics.

Win Tactix highlights correct answers in green and wrong ones in red while revealing the right option. Brief pauses between cards keep the flow clear.

The question library covers rules and pieces including movement, captures, castling, and pawn specials. . Notation basics and symbols from published games appear alongside famous players, world titles, and historic championship matches. International events, national championships, and well-known tournament cities are included, plus federation facts and team competitions that shape modern competitive chess. Whether you follow live events or study on your own, the quiz blends familiar ideas with details that may be new even to regular players.

Win Tactix fits short breaks and longer sessions. Pick a level, read the card, tap an answer, and continue until the round ends. The focus stays on knowledge and steady pacing under the clock.

Tips for stronger runs in Win Tactix. Start on Easy while learning piece names and rules. Try Medium for tournament and cultural facts. Choose Hard for championship history and advanced trivia. Watch the timer and answer at a steady pace.

Replay to beat your best on each level. Compare Easy and Hard results to see where your knowledge is strongest. Wrong answers act as quick lessons because the right option appears before the next question.

Win Tactix is ​​chess trivia in a clean mobile package. Three levels, timed rounds, multiple choice play, score tracking, personal bests, progress feedback, and detailed round results are included. Install Win Tactix and test your chess knowledge. Win Tactix is ​​a chess trivia quiz with Easy, Medium, and Hard rounds.

Ready to test yourself in a crazy run? 🏃‍♂️ Welcome to a game that combines parkour, obby and economic strategy. Here you’ll find a whirlwind run and a real rush across melting platforms, memes and cute memerot to catch and save.

You play as a brave runner rushing through a world where melting tiles vanish underfoot. Each track is a mini parkour obby: leap over gaps, dodge traps, overcome obstacle levels. If you pause for a second, the floor disappears . Along the way you’ll catch funny creatures called memerot inspired by memes. Risk increases with every platform: the further you run, the rarer the trophies. Grab them, give a slap to wake them up and hurry back, otherwise a single wrong jump will cost you all your finds.

Returning to the lobby, place the memerot at your base. Here the game becomes a true tycoon: your pets will bring passive income . Earned coins can be invested in the speed shop and carry shop — boost your speed by +1, +5, +10, increase carrying capacity, open new floors and rooms for memerot . Invest wisely: every upgrade brings you closer to the legendary race. A ritual of rebirth resets your progress but grants permanent bonuses , making the game endlessly replayable.

The world is divided into zones: green hills, futuristic platforms, lava arenas and icy levels. Each has unique obstacles: spinning blades, moving bridges, slippery paths. More than thirty types of memerot are waiting for their hero: funny birds, dancing robots, cosmic kittens. Rare creatures bring more income and unlock special abilities to help in future runs. Collect them and decorate your base!

Your sanctuary can become a real palace: decorate rooms, install arcade machines, create mini parkour tracks for memerot and watch them have fun. For relaxation there’s a tycoon arcade — gather resources, grow exotic plants, unlock merchants offering unique items. Want a challenge? Try the “catch and run” trials where you must catch and deliver as many memerot as possible within a time limit without misstepping.

Beyond the classic mode you’ll find timed challenges that require escape from lava, a survival mode with rapidly vanishing tiles and a crazy mode where everything is sped up. In head‑to‑head you can run alongside a rival, use power‑ups to slow them down or slap them on the shoulder in jest. Seasonal events inspired by memes bring new memerot and quests.

Colourful graphics, funny animations and upbeat music create the feeling of a cheerful race . Intuitive controls are adapted for smartphones, and the game runs smoothly even on low‑end devices . You can also customise your avatar with funny outfits and emotes to make every run feel unique. Join the community, share strategies and compete for records in distance, speed and number of memerot collected. It’s the perfect mix of runner and tycoon for lovers of parkour and obby — like an escape from everyday life into a world where memes come to life.

Download for free and start your journey: save memerot, jump over obstacles, develop your base and prove you are the best in this crazy world! 🚀🏅🎉 Run for monsters & build tycoon! Can you catch all memes?

games.name: Feather Rush
games.description:
Feather Rush is a tap-to-reveal puzzle grid where chickens stand in for mines. You're working a board of hidden tiles, trying to hit a score target before the timer runs out. Some tiles are empty and worth a small bump. Some hide coins, which jump your score in big chunks. Some hide chickens, and chickens are bad news — they scatter your points and waste your moves. Numbered tiles tell you how many chickens are sitting in the eight cells around them, so you spend a lot of time triangulating: this one says 2, that one says 1, the corner nobody's flipped yet is probably the safe one.

The pressure here is the timer. Classic minesweeper lets you sit and stare at a board for as long as you need. Feather Rush gives you about two minutes per mission and a score floor that grows with each level. Mission 1 asks for 600 points, which is easy enough that the game lets you find your footing. By the time you're a few levels in, you're calculating risk versus reward on every flip — is it worth chasing a number cluster when the clock is burning, or do I just gamble on the next row and hope.

The art softens what's underneath. Bright cartoon palette, blue sky, urban street backdrops, a winking rooster mascot on every mission card. The chickens you discover have little expressions. The coins jingle in. It's cute enough that losing doesn't sting too much, which is probably the point.

The achievement structure pulls you in different directions on the same board. Mine Whisperer wants you to clear the grid clean, no chickens hit. Tactical Mind wants you to flag every chicken correctly before winning. Feather Speed ​​wants the win with thirty seconds still on the clock. So you're not optimizing one variable — you can replay the same mission with a different goal in mind and it genuinely changes how you play it.

The daily bonus is a four-by-four tic-tac-toe pull against the house. You're X, the house is O, three in a row in any line, you take the pot. It's a quick palate cleanser between missions and a reason to come back daily.

Coins from missions feed a stats panel that tracks total score, average score, wins versus losses, and games played. There's an Achievements tab that ledgers the named goals — First Flight, Gold Rush, On Fire, Veteran. The progression isn't aggressive; it just sits there as a quiet record of what you've done. Levels unlock in order, so you can see the road ahead, and you can see what's still locked.

What it feels closest to is minesweeper that learned to be friendly, with a score target and a clock stapled on. The friendliness is real — the visuals don't lie. The underlying puzzle is still honest minesweeper deduction, with all the gambling that implies when the timer is shrinking and you've still got rows of unflipped tiles staring back at you. Chickens hide. Coins shine. The clock ticks anyway.

games.name: Bhabhi Thulla
games.description:
Bhabhi Thulla brings the desi card-table classic to your phone — beautifully redesigned for mobile, smooth on every Android device, and packed with features for solo and multiplayer play.

Whether you call it Bhabhi, Bhabi, Thulla, Donkey, or the Getaway card game, you already know the rules — slap down the highest card, dodge the leftover hand, and don't be the last one stuck with cards. Now you can play anywhere, anytime, against smart AI bots or with real friends in private rooms.


★ WHAT'S INSIDE

▸ Online multiplayer — Create a room, share a 5-letter code on WhatsApp, and your friends jump in instantly.
▸ Play vs CPU — 3 to 6 player tables with smart bots that play like real opponents.
▸ Coin tables — Set a buy-in for every seat. Win to collect stakes, escape the Bhabhi to keep your coins, head-to-head draws return everyone's coins.
▸ Daily bonus — Spin the wheel once a day for free coins.
▸ 5,000 starter coins — Hit the ground running, no purchase required.
▸ Guest play OR Google Sign-In — Your coins follow you across devices when signed in.
▸ Real-time game — Sub-second card moves, 30-second turn timers, auto-rejoin on disconnect.


★ HOW TO PLAY

The first player to drop the Ace of Spades opens. Players follow the lead suit; the highest card wins the trick and takes the lead. Can't follow suit? Discard any card and force the trick winner to pick up the pile — that's a Thulla! Run out of cards and you escape (Bhabhi-free). The last player still holding cards becomes the Bhabhi.

Special moves: take all cards from a neighbour to load them up, or surrender a trick you can't win — every choice matters.


★ WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT

✓ Designed for desi card-game lovers in India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and the diaspora.
✓ Smooth portrait-mode UI optimised for one-hand play.
✓ Smart bots that bluff, dump, and play strategically — not random.
✓ Quick games (5–10 minutes per round) — perfect for a chai break.
✓ Private rooms with deep-link invites — tap a link, jump in.
✓ Lightweight, low data usage, runs on every modern Android phone.


★ FOR COMPETITIVE PLAYERS

▸ Set custom coin buy-ins from 500 coins upward.
▸ Bot games scale with table size (500 / 1,000 / 1,500 / 2,000 coins).
▸ Fair zero-sum economy — every escaper wins their buy-in back; the Bhabhi covers all of them.
▸ Mid-game forfeit penalty — leaving costs your stake. No coward exits.


★ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: Is Bhabhi Thulla free?
A: Yes — completely free to download and play. No required purchases.


Q: How many players can join a room?
A: 3 to 6 players per table.

Q: How do I invite friends?
A: From the room lobby, tap "Share Invite" — WhatsApp, Messages, anywhere. Your friend taps the link and lands directly in the room with the code pre-filled.

Q: What's the difference between Bhabhi and Thulla?
A: They're the same game, just regional names. "Bhabhi" (Hindi/Urdu) refers to the last player left holding cards. "Thulla" (Punjabi) refers to the act of forcing an opponent to pick up the trick. Bhabhi Thulla combines both into one classic game.

Q: Will there be tournaments?
A: Yes — leaderboards, daily challenges, and tournament rooms are on the roadmap.


★ ABOUT THE GAME

Bhabhi is one of South Asia's most-loved card games — played at family gatherings, college canteens, and chai stalls for generations. We rebuilt it for mobile with respect for the original gameplay, modern UX, and the feel of a real card table.

Built by South Asian developers, for South Asian card lovers everywhere.

Download Bhabhi Thulla now and find out who's the real cards champion in your circle. Play Bhabhi Thulla online with friends — coins, rooms and daily bonus.

games.name: Favbet
games.description:
Favbet is a fast paced esports trivia quiz built for fans who love testing what they know about competitive gaming. From legendary Dota 2 finals to classic Counter Strike Major moments, every round of Favbet puts your memory and reaction speed to the test. Pick a difficulty, answer fifteen questions before the timer runs out, and aim for your personal best score on every level. The mix of speed and trivia turns each session into a small esports trip down memory lane.

Inside Favbet you will find three clearly separated difficulty modes. Easy is great for warming up and learning the basics of the global esports scene, with friendly questions about famous games, popular publishers, and well known regions. Medium turns up the heat with deeper questions about iconic teams, star players, and tournament moments that shaped the modern competitive era. Hard is built for true scene veterans who follow Valorant Champions, The International, IEM, BLAST Premier, and other top tier events. Each difficulty has its own unique question pool, so the challenge keeps changing as you switch modes and rebuild your run from scratch.

A full round inside Favbet is short, focused, and easy to fit into a quick break. You get sixty seconds on the clock and fifteen multiple choice questions to answer. Every correct answer rewards you with twenty points and pushes your score higher on the live HUD. The wrong answer is highlighted in red and the right one lights up in green, so you always learn something new even when you miss. The compact format is perfect for short trips, queue times, lunch breaks, or those quiet moments when you simply want a fun mental warm up.

The clean interface keeps everything you need on one screen. The top HUD shows your current score, the remaining time, your lives, and the active level, so you can plan your pace at a glance. Big touch friendly answer buttons make it easy to play with one hand on the bus, on the couch, or at your desk.
Favbet covers a wide spread of esports topics. You will see questions about classic and modern Counter Strike, the Dota 2 pro circuit, Valorant world championships, League of Legends World Finals, Rainbow Six Siege Six Invitational, the Overwatch League, fighting game majors, and the rise of Call of Duty competitive play. Favbet also touches the history of legendary organizations like Fnatic, Ninjas in Pyjamas, Astralis, Cloud9, Team Liquid, FURIA, Natus Vincere, FaZe Clan, Team Spirit, OG, Evil Geniuses, and G2 Esports, plus the cities and arenas that turned esports into a true global stage.

Every time you finish a round, the result screen shows your final score, the number of correct answers, time left on the clock, the chosen level, and your personal best for that level. Try to beat your own record on Easy, then move to Medium, and finally aim for a clean run on Hard, where every wrong tap can cost you a place on your own leaderboard.

If you love quick reaction quizzes, modern esports culture, or simply want a smart way to spend a few minutes, Favbet is ready to play. Tap, answer, score, and try again. The format stays light, the questions stay sharp, and your best score is always one round away from a new high. Favbet is an esports trivia quiz with three difficulty levels and 60s rounds

games.name: CogniStreak: Memory Challenge
games.description:
CogniStreak: Memory Challenge


1. How well do you remember?
2. Do you recall concrete words or approximate meanings.

THE GAME
See it. Remember it. Select it.

Words appear on your screen — then vanish. Seconds later they return, hidden among impostors: words that feel eerily familiar but were never there.
Pick only what you actually saw. Nothing more.
Most people fail. Not because they forget — but because their brain generates memories of words that never appeared.

You may recall what you vaguely understood than what you concretely saw.

━━━ WHY THIS IS HARDER THAN IT LOOKS ━━━
Your brain doesn't store reality. It stores patterns.
When you see "Truth," your brain may record "Fact."
When you see "Chair," it already expects "Table."
CogniStreak is built around these predictable errors — using them to reveal exactly how your memory filters and reconstructs what you experience.
━━━ WHAT YOU'LL DISCOVER ━━━
The Meaning Trap — Do you recall exact words, or just their general meaning?
False Familiarity — Why your brain confidently recognises words it never saw.
Pressure Points — Where your accuracy collapses under speed.
Pattern Blindness — Which word groups consistently fool you, and why.
━━━ THE RAI: RECALL AGILITY INDEX ━━━
One score. Three dimensions.
Retention — What you actually held in memory.
Resistance — Your ability to reject convincing impostors.
Latency — The speed of your decisions under pressure.
Maximum: 100. Most players never reach it. You are about to find out where you stand.
━━━ THE DAILY RECALL TRIAL ━━━
Every day at midnight: a new word set. The same challenge for every user worldwide. One attempt. No retries. No replays.
Your score is permanent. Your streak is on the line.
This is not a casual game. It is a daily measure of where your memory stands.
━━━ 50 LEVELS. ONE TRUTH. ━━━
From familiar, concrete words to abstract concepts. From comfortable speeds to pressured recall. Each level is designed to expose a different way your memory misleads you.
━━━ FREE vs PRO ━━━
FREE includes:
· Levels 1–5 to start
· Daily Recall Trial
· Flash Mode — rapid word presentation
· Recall Profile with performance stats
PRO — one-time purchase, no subscription:
· All 50 levels, ad-free
· Speed Mode — 15% faster word presentation
· Challenge Mode — double the impostors
· Endless Mode after Level 50
· Full Tier Weakness Analysis
━━━ THE SCIENCE ━━━
Built on three documented memory phenomena:
False Memory Effect — the brain manufactures confident memories of things it never encountered. Not a flaw. How human memory works.
RSVP Presentation — rapid serial visual presentation, used in cognitive psychology research worldwide.
Fuzzy Trace Theory — why abstract words (Truth, Logic, Justice) are harder to recall accurately than concrete words (Chair, Apple, River).
━━━ IN THE AGE OF AI ━━━
AI remembers everything, finishes your sentences, and handles your cognitive load by default. The question is: how sharp is your own recall when the tools are gone?
CogniStreak doesn't answer that for you. It shows you.
━━━ CLEAN BY DESIGN ━━━
No accounts. No logins. No cloud required.
Works fully offline — your data stays on your device.
━━━ DISCLAIMER ━━━
CogniStreak is an entertainment product. It makes no clinical claims about memory improvement, cognitive health, or neurological function. Word recall game built on false memory effect. Test your short-term memory

HOW TO PLAY?
The premise is simple, but it requires a lot of cunning and wit. A group of friends gets together, but one (or more) is hidden.

Get your card: The game will give everyone a keyword or cultural reference (e.g., "The Obelisk," "Asado," "Mate"). Everyone gets the same one... except the Impostor, who knows nothing!

Debate and lie: The debate rounds begin. You have to give subtle clues without being too obvious. The Impostor has to use all their cunning to blend in, throw fruit at everyone, and make sure no one suspects they're "out of it."

Vote for the suspect: Who was the most smooth-talking? If the Impostor is caught, the honest ones win. If the Impostor manages to frame someone else, they get away with it!

🎮 GAME MODES (Something for everyone)
🎭 The Impostor (The Classic): The classic. One secret word for everyone and an Impostor trying not to get caught. Pure deduction!

🌀 Crazy Mode: Can you handle it? Here, everyone receives different but very similar words. Total confusion reigns, and the Impostor has a golden opportunity for chaos.

✍️ Custom Mode: Your rules, your group! Upload your own inside jokes or keywords to play with friends the way you want.

👥 Who Am I?: Ideal for two players. Take turns asking questions and guessing the other player's hidden character (from Lilo & Stitch to Lightning McQueen).

⚽ Soccer Corner: * Soccer Impostor & Who Am I?: All the soccer folklore in one place. Only for those in the know.

Soccer Tower: A battle of titans. Defend your club (e.g., "Barcelona Players") and try to guess your opponent's by naming players. If you guess wrong, your tower falls!

🔥 WHAT MAKES IT UNIQUE?

100% Argentinian: Full of our references, from Maradona to choripán. The key words will make you laugh and spark lively debates.

Deduction and Nonsense: The fun isn't in the cards, but in what you say. The Impostor has to use his street smarts to survive.

Guaranteed Fun: Ideal for pre-parties, family gatherings, or playing with friends and having a great time. Laughter and heated debates are guaranteed!

ARE YOU READY TO SHOW OFF YOUR CUNNING?
Download "The Argentinian Impostor" now and prove if you're a master of deception or the best lie detective.

Proudly developed by ArFaTech.
Made in Córdoba / Buenos Aires. Debate, lie, and discover the imposter in this fun group game.

games.name: Hamster Loop!
games.description:
Cute hamsters are waiting for your choice on the conveyor belt!
Dive into a fast-paced, highly addictive casual block puzzle game where you deploy hamsters to clear yarn of the exact same color!

There are hamsters of various colors, but they can only attack yarn of their own color.
