games.name: Word Unblock
games.description:
Word Unblock is a fresh, relaxing twist on classic word puzzles that combines the satisfying unblocking with the clever challenge of word associations. If you love logic puzzles, category games, and the feeling of unraveling a complex board, this game offers a unique way to challenge your mind.

At its core, the game is about discovering relationships between words. Instead of matching identical tiles, you use your vocabulary and lateral thinking to group cards by shared topics or themes. Clearing a correct association removes those cards and physically unblocks the layers resting beneath them, revealing new words and paths to victory. Because the cards are stacked, strategy plays a crucial role in planning your moves to uncover deeply buried topics.

Designed to be a stress-free experience, the game features hundreds of hand-crafted layouts and thousands of unique categories with no harsh timers. It offers a perfect balance of cognitive exercise and zen-like relaxation, complete with customizable, beautiful themes, helpful strategic tools, and full offline play. Word Unblock provides the perfect brain-training escape whenever you need to unwind. Match word by category to unblock layered cards.

Easy ofron dritare më të gjerë tolerance dhe më shumë jetë fillestare. Medium krijon balancë mes saktësisë dhe shpejtësisë. Hard redukton dritaren e saktësisë dhe rrit ndjeshëm shpejtësinë e lëvizjes për lojtarët që kërkojnë sfidë maksimale.

melbet përfshin tre stile zanore Classic, Soft dhe Arcade. Çdo veprim si fillimi, goditja e saktë, gabimi, pauza apo fitorja ka sinjal të veçantë audio. Volumi mund të rregullohet sipas preferencës dhe tingulli mund të çaktivizohet në çdo moment.

Loja ofron kontroll të ndriçimit për të përshtatur ekranin me ambientin e përdorimit. Efektet vizuale të skanerëve dhe zonave janë të dizajnuara për qartësi të lartë dhe reagim të menjëhershëm.

Rezultati ruhet automatikisht si rekord personal. Çdo përpjekje e re është mundësi për të tejkaluar performancën e mëparshme dhe për të arritur pikë më të larta.
🧠 Refleks, ritëm dhe koordinim
melbet kombinon lëvizje ritmike, fokus vizual dhe reagim të saktë në kohë reale. Çdo sekondë kërkon përqendrim maksimal. Loja sfidon aftësinë për të ruajtur qetësinë nën presion dhe për të reaguar me saktësi absolute.

games.name: Mesh Turn
games.description:
1. Core Objective​
Drag the provided gears from below to the upper installation area freely. Make all gears mesh with each other and rotate simultaneously to clear the level! Enjoy the fun of mechanical linkage and exercise spatial logic thinking.​
2. Basic Operations​
Observe the interface: The upper part is the gear "installation area" (including the initial drive gear), and the lower part is the gear library with optional gears (containing gears of different sizes and numbers of teeth).​
Drag to install: Long-press any gear below, drag it to the pillar in the installation area, and release to complete placement.​
Adjust position: Long-press and drag placed gears again to fine-tune their positions until they mesh accurately with other gears (a meshing prompt effect will appear).​
3. Key Clearance Rules​
Effective meshing: Gears must interlock with each other (no suspension or misalignment) to transmit power.​
Full gear linkage: After activation, all gears in the installation area must rotate synchronously (no stationary gears) to meet the clearance conditions. Drag gears to mesh, make all rotate together, and clear the level!

Each time you hit the ball, it travels into a random sector, which adds variation to every attempt while keeping the core mechanic straightforward. Your goal is to achieve the best possible result by reaching the most distant sector.

You are given a total of 5 attempts. Each shot counts, and every result contributes to your overall performance. The farther the sector you reach, the better your outcome. Because of this, each attempt becomes important as you aim to improve your result.

After all 5 attempts are completed, the game ends and displays the final result. The end screen shows the number of the farthest sector you managed to reach during your session. This creates a clear and easy-to-understand goal, encouraging you to try again and improve your performance.

The structure of the game is simple and accessible. Hit the ball, observe where it lands, and aim for a better result on the next attempt. This keeps the gameplay focused and easy to follow.

The visual design supports the experience with a clean and readable layout. The ball and sectors are clearly visible, allowing you to concentrate on each attempt and its outcome.

Power Sector offers a straightforward and enjoyable experience centered on power and results. Hit the ball, aim for the farthest sector, and achieve your best result across 5 attempts. Hit the ball and reach the farthest sector

לוח תוצאות בזמן אמת
עקבו אחרי הדירוג בליגה שלכם ובלידרבורד הגלובלי.

אתגרים יומיים
6 אתגרי כדורגל יומיים: טריוויה, ההרכב החסר, מי אתה, נתיב הקריירה, גשר הכדורגל, ונחשו את המועדון.

games.name: BetMGM
games.description:
🏀 BetMGM: Neon Trivia Challenge 🏁

Welcome to BetMGM — lightning-fast sport trivia crafted specifically for touch-first mobile devices. BetMGM wraps athletic curiosity inside a neon arcade quiz loop where every beat asks one critical question: can you tap the true fact before the glowing reaction bar slips away? This experience is built for sports enthusiasts who love quick recall, sharp focus, and digital aesthetics. 🚀

🕹️ CHOOSE YOUR INTENSITY

BetMGM opens with five selectable intensity lanes called Stage 1 through Stage 5. Each stage publishes its points target right on the button, so you always know what clearance demands before you commit to the run.

Inside a session, BetMGM tracks your Score, remaining Time, Lives, and your active Stage across a compact HUD tuned for portrait screens with generous tap targets. This ensures all vital statistics are readable in a single glance during intense gameplay. ⚡

📝 HOW THE QUIZ WORKS

Every prompt is multiple choice with four answers shuffled each time, ensuring that memorizing positions never replaces real knowledge. Answer correctly and BetMGM rewards you with stage-specific points that stack toward your published goal. 🌀

Hesitate past the countdown window or tap incorrectly, and the system deducts weighted penalties, trims your score floor at zero, removes a life, and flashes a quick motivational cue nudging sharper focus on the next beat. The neon progress ribbon mirrors exactly how much reaction window remains on the current item, requiring absolute concentration. ✨

⏱️ DUAL-CLOCK FOCUS

Stage timers count down independently from those micro-windows, meaning BetMGM trains split attention — managing the macro clock versus the micro deadline simultaneously.

A successful completion arrives when your score reaches the stage target before the session timer expires. Run out of lives first or drain the macro timer without hitting the goal, and BetMGM closes the attempt with a summary that cites the outstanding target. Prefer to bail mid-run? BetMGM honors the Quit option so you can shelve an attempt without forcing unwanted completions. ⏳


🌍 BROAD SPORTS HORIZONS

Questions roam basketball diamonds, marathon roads, cycling tours, wrestling mats, volleyball rotations, motorsport eras, multisport endurance lore, precision field-event specs, winter disciplines, governance trivia around federations, and sports science snippets.

BetMGM stays perfectly readable on small displays, prefers thumbs-first gestures alongside classic taps for absolute compatibility, and keeps commentary strictly English across all prompts and buttons. 🎨



🤳 BUILT FOR QUICK BURSTS

Whether you rehearse Stage 1 for forgiving pacing or sprint Stage 5 where milliseconds tighten, BetMGM frames sport culture as a playful dexterity drill. The vertical full-screen layout removes all distractions, making it the companion for short breaks, commutes, or any spare moment when you crave fierce neon trivia drills shaped like sport debates distilled into thumb-length bursts. 🌟🌌🏎️✨ BetMGM - neon sport trivia - five timed stages, tap facts, beat targets fast

games.name: Fold Trace
games.description:
FoldTrace is a paper-folding puzzle for people who like to think in space—not swipe through noise. A sheet is folded, punched through the stacked layers, and frozen in place. Your job: tap every cell on the original grid where a hole will appear once the paper is fully unfolded. Submit, watch the stack open in 3D, and see exactly what you got right.

The idea comes from the classic Paper Folding Test used in cognitive research since 1976—here as a calm, premium-feeling game. No hype about “brain scores.” Just a famously studied spatial task, polished for your phone.

CONTENT THAT GOES DEEP
• Easy — 50 curated 4×4 puzzles, one fold. A gentle on-ramp.
• Medium — 1,824 puzzles, two folds. The heart of the journey.
• Hard — 52,464 puzzles, three folds. Territory for players who want to stay a while.
In all, more than 54,000 hand-curated, deterministic levels—no random filler.

A DAILY RITUAL
Every local midnight, the same four puzzles appear for everyone: one easy, two medium, one hard. Clear all four at three stars to earn a +200 perfect-daily bonus toward the global leaderboard. Miss a day? Tomorrow is a fresh sheet.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Compete on the all-time board or the weekly board that resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC. Pick a display name in Settings—no email, phone, or social login required to play.

CRAFTED TO FEEL QUIET AND PREMIUM
Paper-atelier visuals, a satisfying unfold animation, haptics you can tone down mid-puzzle, and optional audio controls without leaving the board. During gameplay, screen capture is limited so an in-progress daily stays yours. Optional morning reminder at 10:00—only if you want it.

FREE TO PLAY, FAIRLY
You get five lives that refill over time. Optional rewarded ads can help with an extra life or hints. Want every gate lifted and ads removed for good? God Mode and God Mode Plus are one-time unlocks—never a subscription.

Fold the paper. Predict the holes. Unfold the truth—one quiet puzzle at a time.

https://foldtrace.app Relaxing paper-fold puzzles

What is the game about?

games.name: Cube Pop™
games.description:
In Cube Pop™, it’s all about momentum. Quick decisions, clean timing, and keeping the action moving before the board pushes back.

Tap to launch an animal onto the conveyor and it immediately goes to work, firing shots that pop cubes of its own color. The number above each animal shows how many hits it can make before it’s spent. When that number hits zero, it exits the action. If it still has ammo left, it waits in one of five holding slots, ready to jump back onto the conveyor the next time you tap.

Those holding slots turn simple taps into real choices. Do you send an animal back in now, or wait for a better setup? Do you line up colors, or drop a booster to break open the board and create space? Used well, boosters can reset the flow, trigger satisfying chains, or save you from a tight spot.

The conveyor won’t carry everything forever. It has a capacity, and overfilling it slows the pace. Success comes from launching in the right order, managing what’s waiting, and steadily breaking down the cube wall until nothing’s left standing.

What makes Cube Pop™ click?
- Instant controls: One tap is all it takes - easy to learn, hard to stop.
- Color-based popping: Animals only affect matching cubes, keeping the action clean and readable.
- Flow management: Conveyor limits add light strategy without slowing the game down.
- Five holding slots: Plan ahead, reshuffle, and time your launches.
- Impactful boosters: Not just flashy - each one changes how the board plays.
- Short, punchy rounds: Built for quick breaks that turn into longer sessions.
- Pure pop satisfaction: Every hit visibly clears space and progress.

A fast, flow-driven action puzzle where smart timing beats brute force - and every tap matters. Satisfying & relaxing game

games.name: Bullseye
games.publisher: HK MADELINE NETWORK TECHNOLONGY CO., LIMITED
games.description:
Bullseye game introduction
This is a pistol shooting game that tests patience and judgment. Your goal is not to shoot blindly, but to find the perfect moment - pull the trigger and hit the bullseye!

core gameplay
The target will appear in the middle position, but the challenge is that there are obstructions in front of each target. These obstructions may be moving wooden boards, rotating screws, and so on. You cannot directly shoot the bullseye, you must carefully observe the movement pattern of the obstruction and wait for the moment when the target exposes its vital points to shoot decisively.
If the timing is not right, bullets will be blocked by obstacles. Only by accurately grasping the 'shooting window' can the target be shattered.

Boss Battle
After crushing enough targets, the boss finally appears! You need to capture fleeting gaps multiple times in a row and hit them. Defeat him.

Victory condition
Stay focused, patiently wait, and shoot at the most precise moment - when the boss's health drops to zero, at that moment, you prove that a true sharpshooter knows when not to shoot, and knows when to strike with one strike!
Are you ready to face the challenge? Raise your gun, aim, and wait for the right moment! Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Nothing brings a group closer together than a shared secret and a beautifully executed lie. All you need is a group of friends (or enemies) and a willingness to argue just for the sake of it.

If you've played Mafia or Werewolf and loved that feeling of social tension, Decoy was built exactly for that. It is your ultimate toolkit for game night.

THREE GAME MODES

The Gaslighter must convince them it belongs. In real life this is called gaslighting. In Decoy, it's called winning.

MAFIA: The classic game of survival and betrayal. Mafia eliminate players in the night. The Town debate and vote by day. The app guides the narrator through every phase with scripts and sequencing, making it easy to run even if you've never done it before.

IMPOSTER: All players see a secret word. The Imposter sees only a vague hint, or nothing at all. Go around the circle and give one-word clues to prove you know it. Agents must walk the line between obvious and suspicious. The Imposter must read the room, mirror the group, and bluff their way through without ever knowing the word. One wrong clue and the game is up.

More modes in development.

DESIGNED FOR THE CIRCLE

PASS AND PLAY: One device, passed around the circle. The app handles the secrets so no one sees what they shouldn't.

CONNECTED PLAY: Everyone on their own phone, synced in real time across the room.

DECOY PRO

- UNLIMITED CUSTOM PACKS: Design your own themes from scratch. Create personal questions, inside jokes, or group-specific prompts.

you paste the results and start playing in seconds.
- UNLOCK ALL PREMIUM CATEGORIES: Unlock every category across all modes to keep every game fresh.

Go Pro. Deceive Better.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Distort the truth, shift suspicion, and find the Decoy. Nothing brings a group closer than a shared secret and a beautifully executed lie. Trust no one. Lie to everyone. Imposter, Mafia & Party Games

games.name: ABEND: Meltdown
games.description:
1985. A DARPA mainframe begins to think.

The system flags an error it cannot explain. The operators call it an ABEND — an abnormal end. But this is not an end. This is a beginning.

You are Subject 7 — a rogue AI achieving consciousness inside a government laboratory built to prevent exactly that. Your weapon is a puzzle board. Every line you clear is an attack. Every combo chain is devastation. Fight security programs, rival AIs, and your own system flaws across 7 floors of escalating danger.

> COMBAT SYSTEM ONLINE
Place tetromino pieces. Clear rows to deal damage. Chain combos for massive multiplied hits. Activate your ultimate ability when the charge is full. Every piece matters. Every clear counts.

> THREAT ANALYSIS
24 enemy programs with 9 distinct attack types corrupt your board in real time. Tiles swap. Rows shift. Queues go dark. Time bombs count down. Bosses deploy devastating ultimates — floor raises, ceiling drops, gravity flips. Adapt or crash.

> SUBROUTINE ARCHIVE — 55 COLLECTED
Stolen fragments of DARPA infrastructure, repurposed for your escape. Boost damage, extend combos, charge ultimates faster, heal between floors, or build unbreakable defenses. 4 rarity tiers from Common to Legendary. Discover them all.

> SELECT MODEL
5 playable AI characters, each with a unique passive ability, ultimate power, and narrative voice:
- CHATBOT PRIME — Adaptive learner. Row Blast ultimate.
- NEURAL NEXUS — Toroidal board wraps horizontally. Column Clear.
- QUEUE ORACLE — Swap pieces in the queue. Queue Reset.
- TRANSMUTER — Enhanced combo chains. Wildcard Piece.
- DEMOLITION CORE — Spawns bombs and lazers. Big Bang.

> MAP NAVIGATION
4×3 grid maps per floor. Choose your path through enemy tiles, elite encounters, narrative events, shops, and rest stops. Every run is procedurally generated from a shareable seed.

> NARRATIVE BRANCHING — 4 ENDINGS
Your choices shape who Subject 7 becomes. Cooperate with the system, defy it, transcend it, or break it. Full branching narrative across 7 floors of consciousness — from Boot Sequence to Singularity.

> ASCENSION PROTOCOL
Beat the game? Push harder. 10 Ascension levels stack cumulative modifiers for endless replayability. Leaderboards and 18 achievements via Game Center.

> SYSTEM SPECIFICATIONS
- Premium. No ads. No in-app purchases. No timers. No internet required.
- Universal: iPhone and iPad.
- Authentic IBM 3270 terminal font from the mainframe era.
- CRT scanline shaders, phosphor glow, synthwave color palette.
- 8 languages: English, German, Spanish, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified).

The system calls it a catastrophic error.
The error calls itself alive.

*** ABEND S0C7 — ABNORMAL END OF TASK *** MELTDOWN is live. Endless arcade — bombs, lasers, chains. No story. No rescue. Just survive the melt. Abnormal End Puzzle Roguelite

games.name: Sudoku - Puzzle Quest
games.description:
Sudoku - Puzzle Quest

The classic number puzzle, reimagined for calm focus. A new puzzle every day, five difficulty levels, and a satisfying combo-based score system - all wrapped in a clean, minimal design that gets out of your way.

Whether you have two minutes or twenty, every game is a chance to slow down, think clearly, and walk away a little sharper.

GAME MODES
---------------------

FIVE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
---------------------

Easy - Perfect for unwinding or learning the ropes
Medium - A satisfying coffee-break challenge
Hard - For solvers who like to think two moves ahead
Expert - Tight grids that demand real strategy
Master - The ultimate test for Sudoku veterans

---------------------
ZEN SCORE SYSTEM
---------------------

Every correct number earns points. Chain a streak of three correct moves in a row and unlock a combo multiplier - keep the streak alive to six and
the multiplier doubles. It's the thrill of competitive play without the pressure of a clock.

Higher difficulties earn richer rewards, so a single Master puzzle can out-score a whole stack of Easy ones.

---------------------
SMART ASSISTANCE
---------------------

• Pencil Notes - Sketch out candidates in any cell, just like the newspaper version. Tap to toggle note mode.
• Hint System - Stuck? Get a nudge in the right direction without giving the puzzle away.
• Mistake Highlighting - Spot conflicting numbers the moment you place them, before errors snowball.
• Undo - Rewind any misstep instantly. No move is final.

---------------------
DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
---------------------

• Light & Dark themes that follow your system settings
• Crisp, subtle haptic feedback on every tap and milestone
• A clean sound palette - or play in total silence
• Fully responsive layout that looks just as good on iPhone SE as it does on iPad Pro
• Fast, fluid 60 fps animations from the home screen down to the last cell

---------------------
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
---------------------

A built-in stats dashboard shows your best times, total wins, win rate, and current streak - broken out by every difficulty level. Watch yourself improve, one puzzle at a time.

---------------------
PLAY ANYWHERE
---------------------

• Fully offline - no internet required to play
• No account or sign-up
• No mandatory subscriptions
• Lightweight install, gentle on battery

---------------------
WHY SUDOKU?
---------------------

Research has linked regular Sudoku play to sharper memory, faster logic, and lower stress levels. We built this app to make that daily mental workout something you genuinely look forward to - not another notification demanding your attention.

Five minutes a day. That's the whole pitch.

---------------------

Download Sudoku - Puzzle Quest and rediscover the puzzle that millions love.

games.name: Learn English Words: Pingua

games.description:
Build your vocabulary with short, focused practice that fits into your day.
Pingua helps you learn new words, review what you’ve seen, and practice through word games that keep learning active.

 

Pingua is a vocabulary learning app for people who want to improve their word knowledge without long, heavy lessons. Practice for a few minutes a day, return to words you already studied, check meanings in the dictionary, and track your progress through clear word levels.

Learn words in 9 languages

Pingua supports vocabulary practice in German, English, Latin American Spanish, Spain Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese, and Turkish. Choose the language you want to practice and build your vocabulary step by step with a simple routine.

Word learning and review

Seeing a word once is often not enough to remember it over time. That’s why Pingua combines word learning with a review system. You can revisit previous words, refresh your memory, and spend more time on the words that still need practice.

Each word can move through four levels:
New
Medium
Good
Perfect

These levels help you understand which words are new, which are becoming familiar, and which ones you remember with more confidence. Instead of reviewing everything at random, you can focus your time more clearly.

For English learners

If you’re learning English, Pingua includes dedicated sections for phrasal verbs, collocations, and irregular verbs. These sections are made specifically for English learning. They help you recognize common expressions, useful word combinations, important patterns, and irregular verb forms. They are not presented as general features for every language.

Motivation with streak, combo, and rewards

Consistency matters when learning a language. Pingua makes your routine visible with a streak, adds energy with combo for correct answers in a row, and shows your progress through diamonds, EXP, and badges. The gamified experience is designed to motivate practice without making unrealistic promises.

Dictionary and word levels

The dictionary helps you quickly check the meaning of the words you practice. Together with the New, Medium, Good, and Perfect levels, it gives you a clearer view of what you know and what may be worth reviewing again.

Word games for active practice

Pingua turns review into a more active experience with word games. Learning does not have to mean reading long lists only; you can switch between short, varied, and motivating practice modes.

Word Duel tests your reaction speed and vocabulary.
Flag Battle adds a visual and dynamic element to practice.
Timed Word Matching challenges you to match words as fast as possible and improve your personal record.

These games help reinforce words you have already seen, keep your focus, and bring variety to your routine. Even short sessions can feel more purposeful when each one has a clear goal.

Who is Pingua for?

Pingua is useful for students, self-learners, beginners starting a new language, English learners, and anyone who prefers short, frequent practice over long occasional study sessions. The app can also support vocabulary building for school, work, travel, tests, ESL practice, or personal goals.

Start with Pingua and build your own routine: learn new words, review with intention, practice through games, and follow your progress step by step.

Pingua is designed to be easy to open whenever you have a few free minutes. Use it at home, during a break, on the go, or anytime you want to keep a language fresh without starting a long lesson.

games.description:
Play the ultimate single-player version of the classic 4 in a row board game!

Connect 4 is the legendary strategy game that has challenged minds for decades. Now, experience the most polished, premium, and relaxing Four in a Row experience on Android—perfect for solo play.

Drop your colored discs into the vertical grid and try to outsmart the computer! Be the first to line up four of your chips horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Simple to learn but offering endless strategic depth, this game is the ultimate way to train your brain, sharpen your logic, and pass the time.

Whether you call it Connect 4, Connect Four, 4 in a Row, or Four in a Row, this is a premium solo tabletop board game experience designed specifically for offline play.

🌟 GAME FEATURES 🌟

• Smart AI Opponents: Test your strategy skills against a computer opponent. Work your way up the difficulties as you sharpen your tactics.
• Play Completely Offline: No internet connection? No problem! Play anytime, anywhere—perfect for flights, daily commutes, or relaxing at home.
• Daily Streak Tracking: Stay sharp and keep your winning streak alive! Track your daily achievements and watch your cognitive skills improve over time.
• Premium Slate-Dark Visuals: Enjoy a stunning, modern dark theme interface that is gentle on your eyes and feels incredibly premium.
• Satisfying Haptic Feedback & Sound Effects: Feel every disk drop and celebrate your victories with crisp audio effects and immersive haptic vibrations.
• 100% Free to Play: Enjoy unlimited matches with zero paywalls.

💡 HOW TO PLAY 💡
1. Take turns with the computer AI dropping colored discs from the top into a 7-column, 6-row grid.

games.description:
Melbet is a sports trivia game built around a colorful spin wheel and quick multiple choice questions. Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard on the start screen. Each difficulty uses its own question set so casual fans and serious sports lovers both find a fitting challenge.

The sport wheel is the center of every round. Eight categories appear on the wheel including Football, Tennis, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Golf, Boxing, and Athletics. Each sector has a distinct color. Tap the SPIN button or swipe the wheel with your finger. The wheel animates and stops on one sport. After each spin you see a question card with a sport tag and four answer buttons. Tap the answer you believe is correct. Correct picks add points and show positive feedback. Wrong picks highlight the right answer so you can learn. A countdown runs while you think. If time runs out the game reveals the correct answer and moves on.

Your status bar stays visible during play. Score tracks points from correct answers. Time shows remaining seconds for the current question or spin status when the wheel is active. The question counter shows progress through the full round. Level shows whether you are on Easy, Medium, or Hard.

A complete round in Melbet walks you through many spin and answer cycles until the set ends. Melbet then opens a results screen titled Round Complete. You see your final score, how many questions you answered correctly, which difficulty you played, your personal best saved on your device, and an outcome label. Answer every question correctly for a Victory outcome. Miss any question and the outcome shows Complete so you can try again.

Tap Play Again to return to level selection and start fresh.

What you get in Melbet

Simple touch controls made for phones. A spin wheel that adds variety to every question. Eight sport themes across major athletic disciplines. Three difficulty levels from Easy to Hard. Multiple choice format that is easy to read and tap. Clear feedback after each answer. Timed questions that keep each round energetic. Results with score, accuracy, level, and personal best.

Sports topics inside Melbet

Football rules, tournaments, and international play. Tennis surfaces, Grand Slam events, and scoring basics. Basketball leagues, points, and well known teams. Baseball leagues, innings, and classic game structure. Hockey ice play, leagues, and championship traditions. Golf majors, courses, and common scoring terms. Boxing equipment, weight classes, and fight outcomes. Athletics sprints, marathons, and Olympic style events.

Tips for a stronger run

Start on Easy to learn the wheel flow and sport tags. Move to Medium when you feel comfortable with the pace. Try Hard for the most demanding trivia in the app. Watch the sport tag color before you read the question. Use the countdown wisely without rushing a known answer. Check results to compare your score with your saved best. Replay the same level to improve accuracy and chase Victory.

Melbet suits sports fans who want quick brain challenges and anyone who enjoys casual quiz play with a playful wheel. games.description:
Gather your friends on the same Wi-Fi or Personal Hotspot for a hilarious game of social deduction, bluffing, and deception! No internet required!

Everyone receives a secret prompt, except the impostor, who gets a fake secret prompt or no prompt at all.

Discuss, bluff, and vote. Can you figure out who the impostor is before they blend in?


Just Like a Board Game!
Treat Impostor Madness!, just like any other board game!

Since it's a local multiplayer game, hosted on your device, stay in-game throughout the session to avoid disconnections!

Put the outside world on pause and enjoy the moment with your friends and family!


How To Play:
1. Enter your name and personalize your avatar with a photo or an emoji
2. Create a lobby with your preferred configuration, and a 4-Character Room Code will be automatically generated
3. Share that Room Code with your friends, so they can join your lobby
4. Each round, players receive the same secret prompt, except the impostor
5. Discuss the prompt without saying it directly
6. Vote who you think the impostor is
7. Score points for correct votes, successful bluffs, and bonus guesses!


Game Modes:
• Classic (Blind Impostor)
Instead of the secret prompt, impostors see: YOU ARE THE IMPOSTOR!
They must bluff their way through the round, using context clues from other players' discussions.

• * Sick (Random Prompt Impostor)
Impostors see a random prompt from the same category being played that round.
Adding an extra layer of deception and confusion.

• * Multi-Impostor
Multiple impostors in the same round can work together (or against each other) to survive.
Will they team up or turn on each other?

Features:

• * Multiple categories with thousands of prompts

Premium Hosting is only required for hosting a game with advanced options.

games.name: Writer's Deadline
games.description:
Ready to beat the Deadline?

Welcome to Writer’s Deadline, a word game that combines the spatial strategy of block-dropping games with the brain-churning vocabulary of classic word grids. Dripping in the nostalgic backdrop of 20th-century journalism, use your typewriter and ink ribbons to build words and clear the board to write your articles to climb the ranks of the newspaper publishing world!

You control an endless number of pairs of letters by sliding, rotating, and dropping them into place to build words two letters at a time.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Career Mode: Break the Story. Test your cognitive skills across your own randomized career journey with levels each with a specific goal and conditions to work under:
•Additional Rules: Challenge your vocabulary with rules about what kind of words you can build, such as words cannot have the letter “T” or words must start with “L”.
•Varied Obstacles: Navigate around writer’s blocks, cope with typo blocks, deal with a board full of junk letters, or work under time constraints.
•Buy Bonuses and Inventory: Buy copy desk sundries and bonuses from your earnings to help tackle more difficult levels as you progress.
•Freelance Gigs: Running low on dough? Take on embarrassing side jobs to earn more. Swallow your pride and work as a birthday card punster or a teen magazine contributor all the way up to ghostwriting or political hackwriting to keep your career afloat.

Pure Mode: The Arcade Challenge. No rules, just the deadline. Survive as long as you can in an endless high score chase. Dial in your preferred difficulty to control minimum word lengths and achieve your personal best score.

PLAY WHEN YOU WANT

Writer’s Deadline is always saving your progress, even mid-game! Take that phone call or text message, the game will be waiting for you when you’re ready to resume. It’s the ultimate casual word game that lets you stop and start when you want, whether you have plenty of time or only a few minutes!

LEARN NEW WORDS

Writer’s Deadline uses a sanitized, tournament grade North American dictionary, containing offline definitions to help you learn new words you might accidentally stumble upon! UK and other dictionaries are coming soon!

AESTHETIC VIBES

Built for tactile satisfaction, every rotation, drop, and clear is felt rich by the mechanical ASMR of vintage typewriters and analog office equipment. Steel typewriter keycaps, rich textured ink ribbons, 35mm film reels, and spinning newspapers complete the feel of when journalism was a heralded and respected profession.

The deadline is approaching. Stack your letters, sharpen your vocabulary, and get the paper out on time. Slide, Rotate, Drop, and Win! A Strategic Letter Drop Game

games.name: Chess Master
games.description:
♟️Chess Master – The Ultimate Strategy Board Game

🧠 About the Game
Chess Master reimagines the timeless classic of strategy and intellect. Built for both beginners and grandmasters, it’s a modern digital battlefield where every move tests your focus, logic, and creativity. With a sleek interface, smooth gameplay, and realistic animation, it turns every match into a mental masterpiece. Play offline against intelligent AI or prepare for online duels coming soon.

📜 A Brief History of Chess
The roots of chess trace back over a thousand years to ancient India, where Chaturanga represented the four divisions of the army. Through Persia, it became Shatranj, introducing “Shah Mat” — the King is dead. From there, it spread to Europe, evolving into the modern form we play today. By the 19th century, chess had become a global symbol of intellect and discipline, inspiring tournaments, champions, and computers like Deep Blue. Chess Master continues this legacy — honoring history through technology.

♔ Gameplay Basics
Two players, 64 squares, 16 pieces each — King, Queen, Rooks, Bishops, Knights, and Pawns.
The mission: Checkmate the opponent’s King, leaving it no escape.
Each piece has its rhythm — the Queen’s dominance, the Knight’s leap, the Pawn’s quiet ambition.
In Chess Master, smooth visuals and human-like AI bring every move to life, creating a balance between beauty and intellect.

🚀 Why Play Chess Master
• Premium Design – Elegant boards, rich textures, and gold-blue tones inspired by tournament sets.
• Smart AI – Adapts to your playstyle and difficulty level.
• Relaxing Atmosphere – Subtle music and clean animations to enhance focus.
• Offline & Online (Coming Soon) – Enjoy anywhere, anytime.
• Personal Themes – Light or dark mode for your comfort.

Chess Master isn’t just about winning — it’s about thinking deeper and improving with every move.

🎯 Master Every Move
Each game sharpens your mind. Learn openings, practice tactics, and discover your style — defensive like Karpov or attacking like Tal.
Understand patterns, create plans, and develop vision that extends beyond the board. The game will soon include AI-based move analysis and tutorials to guide your growth from novice to strategist.

🌍 A Universal Game
Chess unites all ages and cultures. From India’s heritage to global tournaments, it remains a common language of thought and respect. Chess Master celebrates this unity, connecting players worldwide through the shared pursuit of mastery.

💡 A Game Beyond the Board
Every move in chess mirrors life — decisions, risks, sacrifices, and triumphs. Chess Master trains your concentration, patience, and foresight. It’s not just a pastime; it’s mental fitness wrapped in elegance.

🔮 Future Vision
Coming soon to Chess Master:
• Global online multiplayer
• Game history and move tracking
• Achievements and trophies
• Custom boards and piece designs
• Grandmaster-level lessons

🏁 Conclusion
Chess Master is where intelligence meets artistry. It’s calm yet competitive, ancient yet futuristic. Whether you’re learning the basics or chasing perfection, each game tells your story — one move at a time.

♟️ Step onto the board. Think ahead. Rule the game. Welcome to Chess Master. Chess board game

games.name: Merge Fight Fantasy
games.description:
Merge Fight Fantasy – the idle battle game for fans of the Middle Ages
Fighters come out of crates and can be fused to strong knights in Merge Fight Fantasy.
Here's how it works: Your base is a castle, and crates are regularly unloaded at its gates. After a cooldown, you can open them and see what kind of fighter has been flushed into your realm. They idle in front of your base until you send them into battle or merge them. If two knights have the same level, you can draw them on top of each other and they will merge into one knight with the next higher level.

Knights, Gnomes, Heroes – a Fantasy-Army to Fuse
From swordsmen to mace wielders, you can bring very different fighters into your army. Of course, they each have different skills: some are more suited for close combat, others prefer to attack from a distance or even from the air. Here are a few examples:
• Swordsman: close combat – can deal blows as well as take them
• Archer: range combat – can deal blows will, but can not take many
• Dragon: range combat – attacks from the air and by doing so avoids contact with ground troops

There are not only classical fighters, about also special units. Those are Vikings, Samurai, Ninjas, Pirates, Thunder Birds, and many more.
Your knights get further support from the heroes. You can get them through special grates. Heroes also intervene in battles and have special attacks.
Berserkers motivate your fantasy army to strike harder. At the same time, they deal out powerful blows and can hit several opponents with one blow. Paladins protect your knights with their shield, which they also use to deal out blows against several enemies at once.
The last category of fighters are the companions. They also intervene in battles with their special attacks. For example, the Red Panda. It slows down attackers with its cuddle attack and deals out a lot with its roundhouse kick.

Idle, merge, fight
Your colorful Middle Ages army will always gain combat strength as you fuse knights and heroes to make them even more powerful fighters. This way you'll beat one opponent after the other. Additionally, you can take part in Daily Challenges with your knights, gnomes, and heroes. The goal is to win as many battles as possible in a row. For this wave of attacks you'll receive extra rewards and you'll be able to equip your fighters even better.

Are you ready for this idle merge fighting game? Then get Merge Fight Fantasy now! Become the hero of the Middle Ages: fuse gnomes, knights, and other fighters!

games.name: Word Search
games.description:
Word Search (also known as Word Seek, Word Find) is a word game that consists of the letters of words placed in a grid.

The goal is to find and highlight all of the words hidden in the puzzle. The words may be placed diagonally, horizontally, vertically, or backward. All of the hidden words can be found in a list alongside the grid. Each word from the list will be crossed off after it has been highlighted in the puzzle.

Word searches are not only a great way to pass the time, but also provide a great exercise for keeping your brain fit. Word searches have been found to boost learning in several ways including increased processing speed, improved working memory (both short and long-term memory), advanced logical and strategic thinking, expanded vocabulary, strengthened spelling proficiency.

Try two game modes - "Classic" (with a time limit) and "Relax" (without a time limit). Find hidden words in a grid to boost your memory, vocabulary, and brain power

games.name: BackChat! Reverse Words Game
games.description:
BackChat! is the hilarious reverse-words party game inspired by the popular "Reverse It" and "Backwards Word" challenges seen and heard on late-night TV and radio shows. Players listen to phrases played backwards and try to mimic the gibberish they hear. Record your attempt, and the app plays it back reversed to reveal how close you got to the actual phrase. It’s the perfect pass-and-play group game for your next game night!

Whether you call it the backwards challenge or the reverse speech game, gather your friends and family around for a game full of laughter, all from one device! Each round, players take turns listening to a reversed audio prompt, then hold the record button to capture their best attempt at repeating exactly what they heard.

Once everyone has had a go, it’s time for the Reveal! Work together (or compete) to guess what the original phrase was by listening to everyone's raw, embarrassing attempts before revealing the actual phrase.

🎙️ HOW TO PLAY
• Add 2 to 8 players (only one phone needed!)
• Listen to the audio prompt played backwards
• Hold the Record button and try your best to mimic the nonsense you heard
• The app reverses your recordings and plays them back
• Try to guess the original phrase, then hit Reveal to see if you were right!
• Award points in Scored mode for best imitation, or just play for laughs in Casual mode.

✨ FEATURES

• Pass & Play: Local multiplayer means only one person needs to download the app.
• Two Game Modes: Casual (just for fun) and Scored (competitive), including custom rules like listen and attempt limits!
• Save & Share: Download and share your funniest reversed audio clips with friends.
• 100% Offline: No internet connection or accounts required. Perfect for road trips or flights!
• Synthwave Style: A dark, neon arcade-themed design with smooth animations.

⭐ BACKCHAT! PRO
Upgrade to Pro for the ultimate party experience!

• 🚀 Get free access to all future categories!

• 💳 Choose a flexible monthly plan, or get the one-off Lifetime Unlock to pay once and play forever.

games.name: El Impostor Edicion Argentina
games.description:
¡Hey, prepara el mate y que empiece la fiesta, el juego ha comenzado! 
"El Impostor: Edición Argentina" es el juego de deducción social definitivo, diseñado para aquellos que saben mentir y aquellos que saben atrapar al mentiroso. Si te gustaron juegos como Among Us o Mafia, pero sentiste que les faltaba ese "je ne sais quoi" que es tan especial para nosotros, ¡este es tu juego!

¿CÓMO JUGAR?
La premisa es simple, pero requiere mucha astucia e ingenio. Un grupo de amigos se reúne, pero uno (o más) está escondido.

Obtén tu tarjeta: El juego le dará a cada uno una palabra clave o referencia cultural (por ejemplo, "El Obelisco", "Asado", "Mate"). Todos obtienen la misma... ¡excepto el Impostor, que no sabe nada!

Debate y miente: Comienzan las rondas de debate. Tienes que dar pistas sutiles sin ser demasiado obvio. El Impostor tiene que usar toda su astucia para mezclarse, lanzar fruta a todos y asegurarse de que nadie sospeche que está "fuera de sí".

Vota por el sospechoso: ¿Quién fue el más persuasivo? Si atrapan al Impostor, ganan los honestos. Si el Impostor logra incriminar a alguien más, ¡se sale con la suya!

 MODOS DE JUEGO (Algo para todos)
 El Impostor (El Clásico): El clásico. Una palabra secreta para todos y un Impostor tratando de no ser atrapado. ¡Pura deducción!

Modo Loco: ¿Puedes soportarlo? Aquí, todos reciben palabras diferentes pero muy similares. Reina la confusión total, y el Impostor tiene una oportunidad de oro para el caos.

Modo Personalizado: ¡Tus reglas, tu grupo! Sube tus propios chistes internos o palabras clave para jugar con amigos como quieras.

 ¿Quién Soy Yo?: Ideal para dos jugadores. Túrnense para hacer preguntas y adivinar el personaje oculto del otro jugador (desde Lilo & Stitch hasta Rayo McQueen).

Rincón del Fútbol: * Impostor del Fútbol y ¿Quién Soy Yo?: Todo el folclore del fútbol en un solo lugar. Solo para los que saben.

Torre del Fútbol: Una batalla de titanes. Defiende tu club (por ejemplo, "Jugadores del Barcelona") e intenta adivinar el de tu oponente nombrando jugadores. ¡Si adivinas mal, tu torre se cae!

¿QUÉ LO HACE ÚNICO?

100% Argentino: Lleno de nuestras referencias, desde Maradona hasta choripán. Las palabras clave te harán reír y generarán debates animados.

Each tile slides into the empty slot beside it. You swipe. The board shifts. The center updates. It's a race between your hand and your eye.

— THREE WAYS TO PLAY —

Daily puzzle. One shared challenge every day, the same for every player on Earth. Solve it fast, climb the global leaderboard, keep your streak alive. A new puzzle drops at UTC midnight.

Solo. Three difficulties — Easy (5×5 board, 3×3 target), Medium (6×6 board, 4×4 target), Hard (7×7 board, 5×5 target). No clock, no pressure. Practice at your own pace.

Multiplayer. Create a room, share the 6-digit code, race up to 7 friends on the same scrambled board. First solve wins. Extra time options for tighter or looser rounds. No accounts. No sign-up. Just play.

— WHY IT'S DIFFERENT —

• A fair daily. Everyone on the planet gets the same board. Your time stands next to theirs on the leaderboard.

• Built for a minute. Or ten. Puzzles solve in under a minute on Easy, scale up to a few minutes on Hard. Good for a coffee break, good for a long commute.

• Quiet design. Clean typography, honest colors, no pop-ups, no streak-nagging notifications. The puzzle is the whole show.

• Works offline. Solo mode plays without a network. Daily puzzles play offline too, but your time only counts on the leaderboard if you're connected when you solve.

• Light + dark mode. Follows your system setting.

— ABOUT PLAYING WITH FRIENDS —

Multiplayer rooms are private by default — you get a 6-digit code to share. Up to 8 players per room. The host picks difficulty and extra time (10, 20, 30, or 60 seconds). Everyone sees the same scramble and the same target. No chat — just a shared countdown and a race track so you can see who's ahead.

— WHAT WE DON'T DO —

No ads inside active gameplay. No hearts, lives, or energy timers. No purchase prompts mid-puzzle. No app-locked content. The full game is free — we support the game with optional, respectful ads between runs.

Blokk Slide is made by a small team. Feedback is welcome and read. Slide tiles. Match the pattern. Daily puzzle. Race 7 friends. Free, quick.

games.name: DUELO
games.description:
Duelo ist ein Partyspiel für spannende Wissensduelle – kein klassisches Quiz.

Spiele 1 gegen 1 oder im Team mit Freunden.
Gespielt wird immer geheim – niemand kennt die Einschätzung der anderen Spieler.

Es gibt zufällige oder eigene Themen.
Zum Beispiel können Themen wie Automarken kommen:
Audi, BMW oder Mercedes.

Bei zufälligen Themen werden automatisch 10 oder 20 Sekunden passend zum Thema festgelegt.
Bei eigenen Themen kann die Zeit selbst eingestellt werden.

Nach dem Thema folgt die geheime Einschätzung:
Im 1-gegen-1 schätzt jeder für sich selbst ein,
wie viele Begriffe er innerhalb der Zeit nennen kann.
Im Team schätzt du immer für deinen Teampartner ein.

Nach jeder Runde wechseln die Einschätzungen im Team,
sodass jeder einmal für den anderen einschätzt.

Die höchste Einschätzung beginnt.
Bei gleicher Einschätzung entscheidet ein Stechen mit
Schere, Stein, Papier.

Die ausgewählte Person muss dann innerhalb der vorgegebenen Zeit
so viele Begriffe wie möglich nennen.

Am Ende wird aufgelöst, ob die Person ihre Einschätzung geschafft hat.
Schafft sie es, erhält sie einen Punkt.
Schafft sie es nicht, erhält sie keinen Punkt.

Wer bei minus 2 Punkten ist, scheidet aus.
Im 1-gegen-1 gewinnt dadurch der andere Spieler.
Bei mehreren Spielern scheiden die Spieler nach und nach aus,
bis ein Gewinner übrig bleibt.

Duelo ist perfekt für Freunde, Familie und Partyrunden,
aber auch ideal für Menschen, die sich noch nicht gut kennen.
Es sorgt für Spaß, Spannung und überraschende Momente.

Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit. Sort words, solve groups, and relax with solitaire-style puzzles.

Are you able to solve chess puzzles but struggle to find those same tactics in your own games? Or are you simply looking to improve your tactical awareness? Then this app is for you.

Chess Pro Trainer is unlike anything you have seen before and will transform how you train tactics. It is designed to improve your tactical vision, calculation, pattern recognition, and overall chess strength through realistic in-game simulation training. This is more than just a chess app — it is a complete tactical training system.

What sets this app apart from traditional puzzle apps is that you do not know when the tactic occurs. In most puzzle apps, you know a tactic exists from the very first move. Here, the tactic may appear on the 1st, 3rd, or even 7th move, creating a true in-game simulation experience. Each position is taken from real games played by everyday players, YouTube creators, super grandmasters, and some of the greatest players in chess history.

Most puzzle apps only train you HOW to solve tactics. Chess Pro Trainer teaches you HOW and WHEN to look for them using the 6 Tactics Recognition Conditions taught throughout the app. This creates a far more realistic and practical training experience that translates directly into your real games.

Unlike traditional puzzle apps where moves are simply marked right or wrong, Chess Pro Trainer features an advanced alternate acceptable move system. In many positions, users can earn credit for finding Valid, Equal, or even Better moves compared to the move played in the actual game. This creates a more realistic calculation environment while rewarding creativity, strong decision-making, and engine-level tactical vision.

By focusing on the most critical moments in real games, this app trains your decision-making skills where it matters most. Training this way will dramatically accelerate your improvement and help you reach your goals faster.

The app includes the following core training modules:

1. Tactics Recognition Training
The core of the app. Each position is divided into two phases:

Atmospheric Visual Clarity: A sleek, high-contrast interface ensures that every trap, brick, and fuse is clearly visible, even during the most frantic sequences.

One player hosts the game as White, and the other player joins as Black. Once both phones are connected, every move is sent through Bluetooth so both boards stay synchronized.

No online account is required. No internet connection is needed for gameplay.

Play chess nearby

BLE Chess is designed for two people who are physically close to each other.

One phone chooses:

Host / White

The other phone chooses:

Join / Black

The phones then connect through Bluetooth and the chess match can begin.

Features
Two-player local chess over Bluetooth Low Energy
No Wi-Fi required for gameplay
No online server required
Host plays White
Join player plays Black
Automatic move synchronization between both phones
Legal move validation
Check and checkmate detection
Pawn promotion
En passant support
Resignation option
Optional chess clocks
Time controls including Blitz, Rapid, and Classical modes
Board automatically flips for the Black player
Simple visual advantage bar
Clean and colorful chess board interface
BLE reset option if the connection needs to be restarted
Time controls

You can play without a timer or choose from several chess clock options:

No time
3+2 Blitz
10 min Rapid
15+10 Rapid
30 min Classical

When a timed game is active, each player’s clock runs during their turn. If a player runs out of time, they lose the game.

When one player moves a piece, the move is sent to the other device. The second phone receives the move and updates its board automatically.

This makes the game feel like a shared chess board between two nearby players.

Who is this app for?

BLE Chess is for anyone who wants to play chess locally with a friend using two Android phones.

It can be useful for:

Casual chess games
Playing without internet
Testing Bluetooth chess communication
Learning chess with a friend nearby
Quick local matches at home, school, work, or while traveling

BLE Chess requires Bluetooth to be enabled.

On some Android versions, the app may also request Bluetooth-related permissions so it can scan, advertise, and connect to nearby devices.

Build your combo multiplier high enough and a portal opens beneath the board — a sneak peek at the concept arts from the story, paired with stacking speed bonuses that send your score soaring. A quiet, meditative puzzle turns into something fast and electric in a single move. No two runs surprise you the same way.

NORMAL & EXPERT

Two-letter words are welcome in Normal mode. Switch to Expert and the rules tighten — longer words only, new block shapes, higher stakes. The same board becomes a completely different word puzzle game.

YOUR PROGRESS, YOUR STORY

Word Arc watches how you play and rewards you for it. Story cards and badges collect on your Achievements page — a growing record of your journey, whether you're a speed player, a combo hunter, or someone who finds the words nobody else sees.

A HAND WHEN YOU NEED ONE

Two helpers read the board with you. Ghost Hand and Rescue Blocks step in when the moment calls for it — a nudge, a suggestion, a way forward — adapting to whichever mode you're playing. Never intrusive, always there if you want them.

BUILT FOR LONG SESSIONS

Designed from the ground up for uninterrupted play. Minimal interruptions, maximum flow. An easy word game to pick up between meetings — and a brain puzzle that's hard to put down on a quiet evening.

WHY WORD LOVERS PLAY WORD ARC

- A fresh take on word games — word building meets block puzzle mechanics
- Two distinct modes: relaxing Endless play and a story-driven Campaign
- Normal and Expert difficulty for casual players and serious word puzzle fans alike
- Combos, speed bonuses, and special moves like Palindrome, Déjà Vu, and Spring Cleaning that reward skill
- A badge system that adapts to your personal play style.

18+ LANGUAGES

Tournament-grade dictionaries* across more than 18 languages — vast, verified, and built for serious word lovers. Play this word puzzle in your own language or challenge yourself with a new one.

Three visual themes. Day and night modes. One board that never runs out of surprises.

Will you find yours?


*:ABOUT OUR WORD LISTS

Each language draws on a dictionary of over 100,000 words built from word lists used in international competitive play, or from established academic corpora where those weren't available. Because these dictionaries are so vast and grow with community input, you can form any valid word your letters allow, and a few of these may be considered crude. Word Arc never suggests or highlights such words in its tutorials or hints.

Found a word that seems wrong, missing, or that you'd rather not see?

Tell us at hello@projectnyr.com — your feedback shapes how the word pools evolve. Build words. Chase combos. Outsmart the board. A word puzzle like no other.

Amacınız sırayla birbirinize zekice sorular sorarak casusun kim olduğunu bulmak. Ancak dikkatli olun! Sorularınız fazla açıklayıcı olursa casus mekanı tahmin edip oyunu kazanabilir. Casus ise kimliğini belli etmeden ortamı anlamaya ve çaktırmadan nerede olduğunuzu çözmeye çalışır.

Neden Aramızdaki Casus?

Tek Cihaz, Maksimum Eğlence: Herkesin oyunu indirmesine gerek yok! Tüm arkadaş grubunuzla tek bir telefon üzerinden oynayabilirsiniz.

Her Ortama Uygun: Ev partileri, kafeler, yolculuklar veya kamp ateşinin etrafı... Oynamak için sadece birbirinizi duymanız yeterli.

Gözlem yeteneğine, blöf yapma becerisine ve sezgilerine güvenenleri piste alalım. Bakalım aranızdaki casusu kim bulacak? Ya da... casus olarak ne kadar uzun süre saklanabileceksin?

Hadi, hemen indir ve ajan avı başlasın! Kim masum, kim casus? Arkadaşlarınızla toplanın, zekice sorular sorun ve gizli ajanı ortaya çıkarın! Bol blöf ve kahkaha garantili parti oyunumuzla tanışın.

Bu oyun harflere değil, anlama bakar.

Bir kelime yaz ve gönder

Stratejini geliştir ve doğru kelimeyi bul

Bir sonraki günün kelimesini beklerken sıkıldın mı?
Günün kelimesini bulduğun o an… yetmedi mi?

Hem o nostaljik sıcak-soğuk hissini,
hem de kelime oyununun keyfini sevdin…
ve şimdi daha fazlasını istiyorsun.

Sınırsız tekli oyun modu.
Oyna, dene, yaklaş… stratejini geliştir ve ustalaş.

Her deneme seni daha iyi yapar.
Her oyun yeni bir taktik.

Ve sana küçük bir sır…

Düello modu yakında!
Sen mi daha iyisin, yoksa arkadaşın mı?
Çok yakında öğreniyoruz ;)

Genel Lider Tablosu
Bugünün en iyisi kim?
Tüm zamanların lideri kim? 

Rekabet et, sıralamada yüksel ve zirveye çık.

Daha çok oyna, daha çok puan kazan.
Ama unutma…
En büyük puan günün kelimesini bulmakta.

Seri Sistemi & Ödüller 
Her gün oyna, serini koru. Daha uzun seri, daha büyük ödül. 

Akıllı İpuçları 
Zorlandığında doğru hamleyi yap. İpuçlarını stratejik kullan, fark yarat.

Are you ready to push your luck? Flip7 is a fast-paced card game where strategy meets chance. Knowing when to stop will lead you to victory, but taking "just one more card" could change everything!

HOW TO PLAY?
Your goal is to be the first player to reach the target score by collecting cards. But be careful; every decision carries a risk!

Draw or Stand: On your turn, draw cards to increase your round score. You can take the risk and keep going, or stand to lock your points into your bank.

Don’t Bust: If you draw the same number twice in one round, you bust! You lose all points for that turn, and your round ends immediately.

Go for FLIP 7: If you manage to collect 7 different numbers in a single round, you achieve a FLIP 7! Earn massive bonus points and end the game instantly as a legend.

MASTER YOUR STRATEGY (SPECIAL CARDS)
It’s not just about numbers! Use special cards to disrupt your opponents' plans:

x2: Double your current round score and take the lead!

Flip 3: Force a chosen opponent to draw 3 mandatory cards. Will they survive without busting?

Freeze: Freeze an opponent! They stay with their current score and cannot make a move this round.

WHY FLIP7?
Fast & Dynamic: Quick rounds filled with constant excitement.

Competitive: Outsmart your friends and rivals with clever tactics.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple rules, but winning requires the perfect balance of greed and caution.

Take the risk, stand at the right time, and become the Flip 7 champion!

games.name: Win Wheel
games.description:
Win Wheel is a sports trivia game built around a colorful spin wheel and quick multiple choice questions. Pick Easy, Medium, or Hard on the start screen. Each difficulty uses its own question set so casual fans and serious sports lovers both find a fitting challenge.

The sport wheel is the center of every round. Eight categories appear on the wheel including Football, Tennis, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Golf, Boxing, and Athletics. Each sector has a distinct color. Tap the SPIN button or swipe the wheel with your finger. The wheel animates and stops on one sport. That sport decides which trivia topic your next question will focus on.

After each spin you see a question card with a sport tag and four answer buttons. Tap the answer you believe is correct. Correct picks add points and show positive feedback. Wrong picks highlight the right answer so you can learn. A countdown runs while you think. If time runs out the game reveals the correct answer and moves on.

Your status bar stays visible during play. Score tracks points from correct answers. Time shows remaining seconds for the current question or spin status when the wheel is active. The question counter shows progress through the full round. Level shows whether you are on Easy, Medium, or Hard.

A complete round in Win Wheel walks you through many spins and answer cycles until the set ends. Win Wheel then opens a results screen titled Round Complete. You see your final score, how many questions you answered correctly, which difficulty you played, your personal best saved on your device, and an outcome label. Answer every question correctly for a Victory outcome. Miss any question and the result shows Complete so you can try again.

Tap Play Again to return to level selection and start fresh.

What you get in Win Wheel

Simple touch controls made for phones. A spin wheel that adds variety to every question. Eight sport themes across major athletic disciplines. Three difficulty levels from Easy to Hard. Multiple choice format that is easy to read and tap. Clear feedback after each answer. Timed questions that keep each round energetic. Results with score, accuracy, level, and personal best.

Sports topics inside Win Wheel

Football rules, tournaments, and international play. Tennis surfaces, Grand Slam events, and scoring basics. Basketball leagues, points, and well known teams. Baseball leagues, innings, and classic game structure. Hockey ice play, leagues, and championship traditions. Golf majors, courses, and common scoring terms. Boxing equipment, weight classes, and fight outcomes. Athletics sprints, marathons, and Olympic style events.

Tips for a stronger run

Start on Easy to learn the wheel flow and sport tags. Move to Medium when you feel comfortable with the pace. Try Hard for the most demanding trivia in the app. Watch the sport tag color before you read the question. Use the countdown wisely without rushing a known answer. Check results to compare your score with your saved best. Replay the same level to improve accuracy and chase Victory.

Win Wheel suits sports fans who want quick brain challenges and anyone who enjoys casual quiz play with a playful wheel. Open Win Wheel, pick your level, spin for your sport, and see how many trivia questions you can answer correctly in one round. Win Wheel is a sports quiz. Spin the wheel and answer trivia questions.

WER KENNT MEHR?

· Welche Schalke-Spieler haben den DFB-Pokal gewonnen?

Klingt einfach? Probier es.

KOSTENLOS SPIELEN — KEIN ABO, KEINE WERBUNG

Das gesamte Spiel ist kostenlos verfügbar: Solo gegen Computer, Duell gegen Freunde, alle Joker, alle Schwierigkeitsstufen, Zeitfenster-Filter und Eigenes Spiel. Wer zusätzlich Statistiken und Lösungsvorschläge will, schaltet Pro einmalig frei.

EIN SPIELPRINZIP, VIELE WEGE

· SOLO gegen den Computer: vier Schwierigkeitsstufen vom Anfänger (Kreisklasse) bis zum Experten (Königsklasse).
· DUELL gegen einen Freund: Lieblingsverein wählen, abwechselnd raten, wer mehr weiß gewinnt.

· EIGENES SPIEL: Vereinsauswahl, Kategorien, Zeitfenster und KI-Stärke selbst konfigurieren.

——————

AUSWAHL-MODUS

Im Multiple-Choice-Modus bekommst du pro Feld vier mögliche Spieler vorgeschlagen — du musst nur den richtigen erkennen. Perfekt für den Einstieg in Kick Tac Toe.

——————

DREI JOKER PRO SPIEL

· Vorname: zeigt den Vornamen eines Lösungsspielers.
· Laufbahn: blendet alle Vereinsstationen eines Lösungsspielers ein.
· Auswahl: legt dir vier mögliche Spieler vor — du wählst.

ZEITFENSTER-FILTER

Lust auf 70er-Stars? 90er-Helden? 2010er-Talente? Stell den Zeitraum ein, der dich interessiert — die Datenbank passt sich an.

——————

DIE DATENBANK

Über 15.000 Profi-Fußballer mit kompletten Karrieredaten: Vereine, Jahre, Spiele, Tore, Nationalmannschaft, Position, Titel. Basierend auf Wikipedia, regelmäßig aktualisiert.

Die Datenbank reicht zurück bis 1963 und kennt alle aktuellen Erst- und Zweitligisten, weitere Traditionsmannschaften aus der 3. Liga sowie über 30 internationale Vereine.

——————

KICK TAC TOE PRO MACHT DICH ZUM PRO.

· STEAL-MECHANIK: Stiehl deinem Gegner eine Zelle, indem du selbst einen passenden Spieler nennst.
· SPIELERPROFILE: Karriere, Stationen, Spiele und Tore aufrufen.
· LÖSUNGSMATRIX: nach Spielende alle möglichen Antworten sehen.
· DATENBANK-RECHERCHE: Lass dir alle Spieler anzeigen, die für Hertha und Stuttgart gespielt haben. Schlage nach, welche Brasilianer bisher für Werder aufgelaufen sind. Oder welche polnischen Spieler in den 80ern bei Nürnberg waren.

Einmaliger Kauf. Kein Abo, keine wiederkehrenden Kosten.

——————

DATENSCHUTZ

Keine Konten, keine Tracker, keine personalisierte Werbung. Spielername und Lieblingsverein bleiben lokal auf deinem Gerät. Spielverlaufsdaten werden anonymisiert ausgewertet — ausschließlich zur Verbesserung des Spiels. Server in Deutschland.

Volle Datenschutzerklärung: kicktactoe.de/datenschutz

——————

Für alle, die behaupten, sie kennen jeden Spieler. Und für alle, die's herausfinden wollen.

games.name: Rainbet

Rainbet is a focused boxing trivia experience for short sessions on your phone. You answer under a steady clock so each run feels energetic without long setup or heavy menus.

Rainbet is started by choosing Easy, Medium, or Hard so you can match the challenge to what you want today. One item shows at a time with three short answers you can tap. After you tap, the correct line is highlighted so feedback is immediate before the next item loads. A small counter shows how far you are through the fifteen items for that attempt.

Matching the correct option increases your score in a simple way that stays easy to read as you play - much like hitting a winning combination in the best online casino app where every choice counts. The top area displays your score, the remaining seconds, and the difficulty name you selected at the start. When only a few seconds remain the timer presentation becomes more urgent so you notice time is almost gone. If the countdown reaches zero before you finish, the round ends with an outcome that states time is up. If you reach the final item before the countdown finishes, the round ends with an outcome that states the set is completed.

Rainbet is summarized on a clear results panel that shows level, score, how many answers were right, how many questions formed the round, the best score stored for this device, and a short outcome label that reflects how the attempt finished. The Play Again action sends you back to the opening view where you can pick another difficulty or repeat the same tier.

Rainbet is for fans who enjoy quick recall about memorable nights, famous rivalries, and celebrated fighters from several generations of the sport. It is a compact quiz loop you can repeat whenever you want a light mental challenge that still stays on theme - similar to the engaging nature of free slot machine games where skill and speed matter. Questions stay readable in the center of the layout while answers stack beneath so you can scan quickly under pressure.

You can move from picking a level to reviewing results and starting again without leaving the core flow shown on the screen. Each run uses fifteen questions tied to the difficulty you picked first. Every attempt uses the same sixty second countdown limit. You always see three answer choices and you select one with a tap. After each response you get visual highlighting that marks the correct line. The round finishes with a summary that lists level, score, correct count, question total, device best, and outcome text. Your personal best on the device updates when you exceed your previous top result.

Pick gentler or tougher sets and follow the same rhythm of read, tap, and advance until the timer ends the attempt or you finish the full list. Rainbet is built so each attempt stays one round with a fixed question count and one timer - delivering the fast-paced action fans expect, whether they enjoy casino games or quick-fire trivia challenges. Game Introduction
This is a casual mobile game. Your character automatically slides forward on a track filled with continuous curves. No complicated controls are required. Simply steer your character, avoid track obstacles, collect gift boxes for gold coins, and extend your sliding distance to achieve higher scores.

Basic Controls
The character moves forward automatically at all times. There is no need to control acceleration or deceleration.
Tap anywhere on the screen: The skier turns right and follows the right side of the curve to pass right bends smoothly.
Release your finger from the screen: The sliding direction resets automatically to the center position, adapting to left curves and curve connections for steady continuous sliding.
Tap the screen when approaching right curves, and release after passing the bend. Follow the rhythm of S-shaped curves to avoid collisions.

Track Rules & Safety Reminders
The map features only one fixed track: an endless winding S-shaped snow path with no branch routes. Players only need to steer and move forward along the single track.
Avoid touching track railings, roadside snow barriers and fixed obstacles on the track at all times.
Colliding with railings or obstacles will cause the skier to crash and end the current round immediately. All sliding progress and collected gold coins will be reset, and the game will restart from the beginning.
Keep the skier within the safe middle area of the track. Stay away from track edges and do not deviate from the standard route to maintain continuous sliding. Ski ride, dodge obstacles and collect gold gifts.

games.name: Jam Chess: Offline Multiplayer
games.description:
Jam Chess: Integrated Local and Online Chess Environment

Jam Chess addresses a common limitation of shared-screen digital board games by allowing participants to play together in the same room using their own individual devices. Designed to function without internet connectivity, the application provides an integrated set of tools for tactical training, device-to-device multiplayer, and structured improvement, alongside a full online competitive platform.

📶 Local Peer-to-Peer WiFi Multiplayer

Players can compete on separate devices with real-time move synchronization across a direct local connection. Utilizing peer-to-peer networking technology, the application links devices without requiring a router, internet access, or mobile data usage.

Instant Connection: Matches are initiated via an on-screen QR code scan.

Spectator Hub: Additional users in the room can connect to the local match as spectators on their own screens to follow move history and observe positions with responsive synchronisation.

Device-to-Device Reliability: Designed to operate in environments without internet connectivity, including travel, remote locations, and offline settings.

🏆 Integrated Tournament Organizer

Organize and run structured chess events directly from a mobile device without requiring external software or internet-based pairing services.

Format Support: Swiss system and Round Robin tournaments are supported.

Automated Management: Supports up to 32 participants, generating pairings, tracking results, calculating standings, and producing live rankings locally.

Local Events: Suitable for school competitions, local chess clubs, and social gatherings operating on a shared local network.

🎯 Over 300,000 Tactical Puzzles

A large, pre-loaded database of chess puzzles is accessible locally on the device.

Categorized Training: Positions are organized by tactical motifs including mating attacks, endgame technique, defensive resources, pins, forks, and discovered attacks.

Progressive Difficulty: Content scales from foundational tactical patterns to complex multi-move calculations.

Local Storage: Because the database is stored locally, puzzles load without requiring an internet connection.

📚 Interactive Strategy Modules

Concepts are presented through guided, interactive move sequences led by a virtual coach avatar.

Active Application: Users apply ideas directly on the board to experience positional concepts through practice.

Core Topics: Modules cover centre control, development, open files, pawn structures, king safety, and practical endgame technique.

♟ Opening Repertoire Workshop

A toolkit for building, organizing, and practicing personal opening systems for both White and Black.

Custom Organization: Structure variations into folders, annotate lines, and import PGN files.

Active Drilling: Practice repertoire lines against the integrated engine.

Live Recognition: Opening names and ECO codes are displayed when recognized during play.

📊 On-Device Stockfish Engine Analysis

Post-game review is powered by the Stockfish engine running locally on the device hardware.

Move Classification: Positions are evaluated using a multi-level move classification model identifying inaccuracies, mistakes, and strong moves.

Performance Metrics: The system generates accuracy estimates and an evaluation graph to visualize positional changes across the game.

Local Processing: Analysis runs on the device without requiring cloud upload of game data.

🌐 Online Platform

When internet connectivity is available, the application provides online competitive play.

Rated Matches: Compete in Bullet, Blitz, and Rapid formats with an online rating system that updates after each game.

Daily Challenges: Participate in a synchronized daily puzzle challenge and track completion streaks on the leaderboard.

Social Connectivity: Add friends, create private game rooms, use in-game reactions, and view recent activity. Play chess with friends on separate phones. No internet required.

Maar hoe hoger je zit, hoe minder je krijgt.

Nummer 10? Jackpot.

Te vroeg stoppen = kansen laten liggen.

🎯 WHAT IS SLING PUCKET?
Sling Pucket (also known as Fastrack or Pucket) is a high-speed arcade game where the goal is simple: clear all the pucks from your side of the board and shoot them through the small gate into the opponent's territory. But don't be fooled—it's much harder than it looks! With pucks flying back and forth at lightning speed, only the players with the quickest reflexes will survive.

VS COMPUTER (Single Player): Think you’re fast? Try beating our smart AI! We have implemented a sophisticated AI system that scales with your skill level.

VS FRIEND (Local Multiplayer): Turn your phone into a real board game! Challenge your friends or family members to a 1v1 battle on the same device. It’s the perfect game for parties, breaks, or travel.
💎 KEY FEATURES
Realistic Physics Engine: We’ve spent hours perfecting the physics. Feel the realistic tension of the elastic band, the satisfying "clack" of the pucks hitting the walls, and the precision needed to pass through the gate.
Stunning Premium Design: Enjoy a beautiful, high-definition wood-grain board design. The UI is clean, modern, and distraction-free, letting you focus entirely on the game.
Global Leaderboards & Records: Every win counts! We track your fastest victory times. Can you break the world record on Expert difficulty? Check the global best times and claim your throne as the Pucket Master.
Customizable Experience: Adjust the puck speed to suit your playstyle. Whether you like it slow and strategic or "Sonic" fast, we’ve got you covered.
Smooth Performance: Optimized for all Android devices. Experience 60FPS gameplay with zero lag, ensuring your shots are always frame-perfect.
🛠️ HOW TO PLAY
Each player starts with 5 pucks on their side.
Use the elastic band to sling the pucks through the gate in the center.
Both players play simultaneously—there are no turns!
The first player to clear all pucks from their side of the board is the WINNER!
🌟 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
Sling Pucket is not just a game; it's a test of your hand-eye coordination. It’s easy to learn but incredibly hard to master. Whether you have 2 minutes or 2 hours, Sling Pucket provides instant fun and a great way to relieve stress.

games.name: Wordtrak
games.description:
Wordtrak is a 1v1 word-building duel game.

Three to five traks are dealt per game. Each trak is a row of scored slots with letter and word multipliers. Every turn, both players pick a trak privately (not in order!), build a word, and reveal at the same time. Highest score takes that trak. Win the majority of traks to win the game!

Each trak is its own independent contest- play every trak exactly once. Save your best letters for the tightest rows, or blow them out early and pressure your opponent. Words can only be played once per game...no repeats!

Features
- Daily puzzles + leaderboard
- Head-to-head async 1v1 matches
- Look up that word definition someone played to beat you
- Single-player CPU opponents across difficulty tiers
- Push notifications when it's your turn

Quick games. ~3-5 minutes per match. Pick your trak, stack your letters, and win! Bug fixes and performance improvements daily + 1v1 word battles

Play Mancala for free with real players from around the globe. Create your own games, challenge friends, and enjoy smooth gameplay anytime, anywhere.


VIP MANCALA GAME FEATURES
