Qvnt funcționează complet offline. Nu colectăm date, nu afișăm reclame și nu cerem înregistrare. Deschizi aplicația, joci, gata.

◆ DESIGN CALD, MINIMALIST
Fonturi editoriale, culori calde de hârtie și accente de teracotă. Un design care se simte ca o revistă de cuvinte încrucișate, nu ca o aplicație agresivă.

Atinge orice cuvânt ghicit pentru a-i vedea definiția în DEXonline.

Numele „Qvnt" vine de la „cuvânt" fără vocale — exact ca în joc, literele lipsă așteaptă să fie descoperite.

Ai ghicit cuvântul de azi?

games.name: Scrambly Word Game
games.description:
Scrambly is a classic anagram game with no stress, no spam, and no pressure.

Every puzzle shows you a set of scrambled letters. Your job: find every word that uses all those letters. Simple. The catch is that there's almost always more than one answer hiding in there — and the fun is in noticing them.

How it works
- Tap or swipe the letters to build a word
-Use all the letters — every answer is a full-length anagram
- Find as many as you can in 60 seconds
- Shuffle the tiles anytime to see the letters a different way
- Score points based on word length
- Climb the Game Center leaderboard for your highest round

Why Scrambly feels different:
Most word games on the App Store are built to hook you, harass you, and push you toward in-app purchases. Scrambly isn't. There are no paywalls, no energy meters, no daily-reward guilt trips. Just a finite collection of handcrafted anagram puzzles — the same kind you've seen in newspapers and crossword books for decades — drawn from a list of common English words with real anagram siblings.
The background drifts slowly behind your letters. The sounds are soft. The feedback is gentle. The timer gives you enough room to think. It's a word game designed for actual humans who like words.

Features:
- Hundreds of real anagram groups, hand-curated from common English
- 3-letter through 10-letter puzzles of increasing challenge
- Tap or swipe input — pick whichever feels right
- Shuffle button to rearrange letters on demand
- Game Center leaderboard for your personal best
- Full statistics tracking: games played, longest word, streaks, and more
- Clean, accessible design tuned for iPhone and iPad
- Supports VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and Reduced Motion
- One-handed play, portrait-only on iPhone, both orientations on iPad

Made by a word game fan: 
Scrambly is built by Peter, the creator of the Apptato YouTube channel — home to thousands of word puzzle videos watched by people who genuinely love unscrambling letters. This app is the version of a word game he wanted to play himself. No aggressive monetization. No pay-to-win. No gimmicks.
Just you, the letters, and the words you can find in them.

A note on ads:
Scrambly is free and supported by occasional ads between rounds. We never interrupt gameplay, never show ads during a puzzle, and cap the ad frequency so you're not bombarded. If you play a short round, you probably won't see an ad at all.

games.name: Singapore Life Simulator

Live a Singapore life, one swipe at a time.

You're born in a heartland HDB in 1995. Or 2003. Or 1988. Pa was a quiet
Lianhe Zaobao reader. Mum was a tiger parent. Or maybe Pa drove a taxi
and Mum stretched a CDC voucher every month.

Either way — here you are.

Swipe right to take the kopi. Swipe left to refuse. Swipe left to take
the GEP test, swipe right to refuse.

Each card moves you forward through PSLE results day, ORD or skipping
it, your first job, your first heartbreak, the small CNY dinners and the
big ones, until one day the cards run out and you get an eulogy.

That's the game.

— FOUR METERS TRACK YOUR LIFE —
Wealth. Happiness. Family. Reputation. Push any one to the extreme and
it kills you in a different way: the cancelled civil servant, the
smothered patriarch, the CPIB casualty, the smiling delusion. There's
no winning. Only the life you choose to lead.

— EVERY LIFE IS DIFFERENT —
Race, family background, and birth year are randomly assigned at the
start. Hawker mum or condo mum? Hokkien Ah Ma or Tamil Paati? Born in
1985 or 2005? Story arcs branch quietly. The same swipe doesn't always
lead to the same outcome.

— ELEVEN ENDINGS —
A chalkboard menu for the beloved hawker. The Twitter cancel-feed of a
fallen influencer. The sepia frame of an HDB Saint. A banker's quiet
statement. A CPIB folder. A kopitiam for the Heartland Hero. A
Bloomberg terminal for the Disillusioned Banker. A 2am kitchen for the
Caregiver Burnt Out. A washed-pastel snapshot for the Beautiful
Delusion. A green felt table for the Gambler. A short obituary in
serif. Each ending fits the life you led.

— 472 MOMENTS —
Ah Ma's last ang bao. PSLE results day. The SAF11B you waved on ORD
day. CNY reunion dinner with the auntie who never stops asking when
you're getting married. NDP funpacks. F1 night. Hari Raya open house.
Deepavali lights at Little India. The void deck wake.

— THINGS YOU CARRIED —
Pa's old Seiko. Ah Ma's last ang bao. Nenek's last duit raya. Paati's
Deepavali packet. The wedding ring. The grandchild's first drawing.
Each life accumulates heirlooms — they show up in your eulogy as the
things you took with you.

— 78 ACHIEVEMENTS —
Hawker Tycoon. Heartland Hero. Got into GEP. Survived NS combat
vocation. Bought condo. Lived to 90. Disillusioned Banker. Smothered
Patriarch. Unlocks persist across lives.

No ads. No subscriptions. No menus.
One swipe at a time. Birth to eulogy.

Made in Singapore. Light Singlish throughout — but you don't need
to be Singaporean to play. Swipe through a Singapore life. From the KK hospital to the eulogy.

games.name: SuperBrain - Codebreaker
games.description:
Knacke den Code. Jeden Tag.

SuperBrain ist ein modernes Logikrätsel im Geist eines Mastermind-Klassikers. Ein verdeckter Code aus vier farbigen Steinen, zehn Versuche, präzise Hinweise nach jedem Zug. Kein Glück, kein Bling, keine Werbung – nur Schritt für Schritt zur richtigen Lösung.

Das Spiel ist für die fünf Minuten zwischen Kaffee und Meeting. Für den Bus. Fürs Warten in der Schlange. Statt ziellos zu scrollen, denkst du. Jeden Tag ein bisschen schärfer.

So funktioniert es

Du errätst eine geheime Farbkombination. Nach jedem Versuch siehst du Hinweise. Ein schwarzer Punkt heißt: eine Farbe steht an der richtigen Stelle. Ein weißer Punkt heißt: die Farbe gehört zwar in den Code, aber nicht an diese Position. Aus diesen Hinweisen schließt du, was wahr sein muss – und was sicher nicht.

Die Schwierigkeit Leicht mit fünf Farben spielst du kostenlos, so oft du willst. Mittel (sechs Farben) und Schwer (sieben Farben, ein Stein mehr) gehören zu SuperBrain Premium – mehr dazu weiter unten.

Der Daily Code

Einmal pro Tag derselbe Code, weltweit identisch, nur für 24 Stunden lösbar. Wer ihn knackt, baut eine Serie auf. Wer einen Tag vergisst, verbraucht automatisch einen Streak Freeze – also kein "alles verloren, weil einmal vergessen". Der Daily Code ist immer kostenlos.

Was deinen Fortschritt sichtbar macht

• Level- und XP-System für jeden gelösten Code
• Bestzeit, Versuchsverteilung und eine 90-Tage-Heatmap deiner Spielhistorie
• Identitätstitel von Lehrling bis Großmeister
• Wochen-Challenge mit XP-Bonus, die jeden Montag wechselt

Cosmetics, die du verdienst

Fünf Peg-Stile lassen sich durch Spielen freischalten: Klassisch, Ring, Konzentrisch, Dawn, Geprägt. Keine Loot-Boxen. Kein Bezahlen. Du sammelst sie durch Level, Streaks und Achievements.

SuperBrain Premium

Premium ist eine optionale Erweiterung über In-App-Kauf. Drei Pläne stehen zur Wahl: monatlich, jährlich oder einmalig (Lifetime). Was damit dazukommt:

• Schwierigkeit Mittel: sechs Farben, vier Stellen
• Schwierigkeit Schwer: sieben Farben, fünf Stellen
• Vollständige Entwicklungsstatistik mit Versuchen, Zeit, Lösungsquote und Trend pro Schwierigkeit

Mehr gibt es nicht zu kaufen. Daily Code, Schwierigkeit Leicht, Cosmetics, Streak, Wochen-Challenge und der Großteil der App bleiben dauerhaft kostenlos.

Privatsphäre ohne Sternchen

Keine Werbung. Kein Cross-App-Tracking. Kein Account-Zwang. Dein Fortschritt liegt auf deinem Gerät. Wenn du iCloud nutzt, synchronisiert sich der Stand zwischen iPhone und iPad – verschlüsselt, an deine Apple-ID gebunden.

Eine Erinnerung, falls du sie willst

Du kannst dir am Abend einen kurzen Hinweis schicken lassen, dass die heutige Daily noch offen ist. Zeit wählbar. Jederzeit aus. Sonst lassen wir dich in Ruhe.

Design und Zugänglichkeit

Schlicht, warm, ohne visuellen Lärm. Geist und Instrument Serif als Schriften. Inspiriert von NYT Games, Linear und Duolingo. Mit Farbblind-Modus, haptischem Feedback und drei Themes: Hell, Dunkel und Klassisch.

المدرّج هو التطبيق اللي هيخليك تثبت إنك فاهم كورة بجد. مش بس بتتفرج على الماتشات، إنت بتعرف اللاعيبة، التشكيلات، الملاعب، وكل التفاصيل. اتحدى صحابك، العب لوحدك، أو شارك في التحدي اليومي.

خمس طرق لعب مختلفة:

خمّن
لاعيب غامض وعندك تلميحات. اكشفهم واحد واحد لحد ما تعرف هو مين. كل تلميح هيقللك النقط. تقدر تعرفه من غير ما تكشف كله؟

التشكيلة
ماتش بتشكيلته الكاملة قدامك، بس الأسامي مخفية. حط كل لاعيب في مكانه الصح وإنت تحت ضغط الوقت. مود التحدي بين اتنين هيقلب الجلسة لمعركة بالنوبة. أول واحد يكمّل الإحدعشر يكسب.

مسيرة
سيرة لاعيب من غير اسم. الأندية اللي لعب فيها، السنين، البلاد. عندك تلات محاولات تعرفه قبل ما يطلع منك.

مسلسل
لعبة جماعية على موبايل واحد. فريقك يوصفلك اللاعيب من غير ما يقول اسمه ولا اسم ناديه، وإنت تخمّن. أكتر فريق ياخد لاعيبة في الوقت يكسب. مثالية للقعدات والسحبيات.

الملاعب
صورة ملعب قدامك. اعرفه من السعة، البلد، أو النادي اللي بيلعب فيه. كل تلميح بيكلفك من النقط، فاحسبها صح.

مميزات تانية:

التحدي اليومي: لاعيب جديد كل يوم. سيب بصمتك في الليدر بورد.
شير مع صحابك: ابعت لينك التحدي وخلي صاحبك يلعب نفس الجلسة ويشوف هو أحسن منك ولا إنت.
ليدر بورد: شوف ترتيبك بين عشاق الكورة في مصر والوطن العربي.
محتوى عربي أصيل: أسامي اللاعيبة والأندية والمسابقات بالعربي زي ما الجمهور بيقولها.
بدون تعقيد: تصميم خفيف وسريع، يشتغل حتى على شبكات ضعيفة.

ليه المدرّج؟

مش مجرد كويز عشوائي. كل سؤال متظبط بإيد ناس بتفهم في الكورة. من الدوري الإنجليزي والإسباني، للدوري المصري والأفريقي، للمنتخبات والكأس العالم. لو كنت بتتفرج على الكورة من زمان أو من جيل ميسي ورونالدو، هتلاقي اللي يتحداك.

نزّل دلوقتي وابدأ تثبت إنك مدرّج حقيقي.

games.name: Coil Party

CoilParty is a live puzzle race you play together in the same room.

One person starts a party. Everyone else joins by scanning a QR code or typing a short room code. The puzzle appears on every phone at the same moment, and the race is on. First to untangle the coil takes the round. Win enough rounds and you take the party.

And here is the twist that turns friends into rivals. The moment you are about to lock in your solution, anyone else in the party can spend a power up to shuffle your board. Watch their face the second their puzzle scrambles. Listen to the room erupt. The lead changes in the last two seconds of almost every round.

No accounts. No sign ups. No email. No password. You open the app and play.

Free forever. No ads. No in app purchases. No paywalls.

Built for the kind of moments where a normal board game would be too slow and a video call would feel weird. Pull it out at a dinner, a road trip pit stop, a classroom break, a family hangout, a long wait at the airport. As long as everyone has a phone, you have a party.

WHY PEOPLE KEEP IT ON THEIR HOME SCREEN

Fast to start. A party is live in under ten seconds.

Easy to teach. The whole game is one rule. Untangle the coil before anyone else does, and sabotage the player who is about to beat you.

Built for groups. Bring in your roommates, your cousins, your whole study group. Everyone races at once on their own screen, against the same puzzle.

Calm to look at. Warm colors, gentle motion, zero flashing ads, zero pop ups begging you to rate.

Respectful of your phone. Tiny download. Light on battery. No tracking ad networks. No data sold to anyone.

HOW A ROUND WORKS

1. Host taps Create Party. A six character code appears.
2. Everyone else taps Join and enters the code, or scans the QR.
3. The same puzzle drops on every device.
4. Race. Untangle. Shuffle your rivals. Beat the room.
5. Scoreboard updates live. Next round starts when the host is ready.

GOOD FOR

Family game nights. Friend hangouts. Couples on the couch. Classrooms. Office lunches. Bachelor and bachelorette parties. Long flights with cousins. Dorm rooms at midnight. Anywhere a group has phones and five minutes to spare.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

Ask for your email. Ask for your name. Send you push notifications you did not sign up for. Show ads between rounds. Lock content behind a subscription. Track you across other apps. Sell your data.

PRIVACY IN ONE SENTENCE

CoilParty does not collect personal information. Gameplay state is synced anonymously so devices in the same party stay in sync. Full policy at https://coilparty.web.app/privacy

Made by an indie developer. No publisher. No investors. No growth team writing manipulative copy. Just a puzzle game built to make the room laugh.

Pull out your phones. Start a party. Shuffle your friends. See who wins.

**Water Sort Puzzle** is a simple, fun, and highly strategic logic game designed to test your logical reasoning and patience. If you're looking for a pastime that exercises your brain without causing stress, this is the perfect game for you.

### How to Play?

The mechanics are intuitive, but the challenge increases with each level:
1. **Tap any jar** to pour the colored water into another jar.

2. **The rule is clear:** you can only pour the water if it is the same color as the top layer of the destination jar and if there is enough space.

3. **The ultimate goal** is to separate all the colors so that each jar contains only one unique color.

### Why play Water Sort Puzzle?

* **Elite Brain Exercise:** Stimulate your cognitive skills and your ability to plan strategically.

* **Progressive Difficulty:** Start with simple levels and advance to complex challenges that will demand every ounce of your focus.

* **No Pressure:** There are no timers or time limits. Play at your own pace, relax, and think carefully before each move.

* **Minimalist and Elegant Design:** Enjoy a clean look, vibrant colors, and soothing water sounds that provide a therapeutic experience.

* **Works Offline:** No internet? No problem! Play anywhere, whether on the subway, in a waiting room, or in the comfort of your home.

### Premium Version Highlights:
* **Uninterrupted Experience:** As a paid app, you focus only on the fun and the challenge.

* **Hundreds of Levels:** A vast library of levels to guarantee hours of entertainment.

* **Undo Button:** Made a mistake? Use the undo function to correct your strategy without having to restart the level.

* **Lightweight and Fast:** Optimized to work perfectly on various Android devices without taking up much space.

---

**Get ready to organize the colorful chaos!**

**Water Sort Puzzle** is more than a game; it's a test of intelligence hidden beneath a relaxing mechanic. Can you predict the moves and solve the most difficult levels with the fewest moves possible?

**Download now and prove you're a master of logic!**

---
*Developed by Aristófanes Paulino.* Challenge your mind: organize the colors and solve the most addictive water puzzle!

Gameplay: Colorful balloons spawn at the bottom of the screen and float upwards. Your task is to tap them as quickly as possible before they reach the top.

games.name: Soccer Target Rush
games.description:
Soccer Target Rush is a focused arcade-style football challenge built around precision shots, timing, and a clear objective. The gameplay is simple and easy to understand: kick the ball toward a target and complete all attempts within a limited time.

The player is given 8 attempts to kick the ball toward the target. Each shot sends the ball toward a random point, which means every attempt requires attention and readiness to react to the outcome. Because of this randomness, the gameplay remains dynamic while still keeping the core objective clear and consistent.

The main task is to complete all 8 kicks successfully within the given time. A timer is always active during the session, adding pressure and requiring quick decisions. You need to act efficiently and use every attempt without hesitation. If the player manages to complete all 8 kicks before the timer reaches zero, the game ends with a victory screen and displays the results.

However, if the time runs out before all attempts are used, the game immediately restarts. This creates a clear success and failure condition, making each session focused and goal-oriented. The combination of limited attempts and time restriction ensures that every action matters and every second counts.

Soccer Target Rush follows the classic arcade principle of simple rules combined with skill-based execution, where accuracy and timing play a key role in achieving results ([tintedwindowsmusic.com][1]). The structure remains compact and easy to follow, allowing players to quickly understand the objective and jump straight into the gameplay.

The visual presentation supports the experience with a clean and clear design. The ball, target, and playing area are easy to recognize, helping you stay focused on your actions and timing. This clarity ensures that each attempt feels direct and responsive.

The game is built around repetition and improvement. Each session gives you another chance to complete all 8 shots faster and more efficiently. The more you play, the better your reaction and timing become, allowing you to achieve better results.

Soccer Target Rush delivers a straightforward and engaging football arcade experience. Kick the ball, complete all 8 attempts, beat the timer, and reach the final result screen. games.name: Hot & Cold
games.description:
Find the secret word. One guess at a time.

Hot & Cold is a daily word puzzle that challenges how you think — not just
what you know. Every guess you make gets ranked. The closer its meaning
to the secret word, the hotter you are.

🔥 Hot? You're close. Keep pushing.
❄️ Cold? You're way off. Think differently.
☀️ Warm? You're circling it. Almost there.

There's no letter grid. No crossword. Every word in the English language
has been ranked by how close it is in meaning to today's secret word —
so "rain" might rank higher than "water" even though they seem similar.
Every game teaches you something new about language.

Compete daily
──────────────
After you finish, see exactly how your score compares to everyone who
played that day. Guessed it in 6? Thousands of people took 30.

Free to play
──────────────
Two new puzzles every day, completely free — Easy (no sign-up needed) and
Medium (free with an account). See how you stack up against every other player.

Hot & Cold Pro
──────────────
Unlock the daily Hard game and play unlimited extra puzzles beyond your two free.
Get unlimited hints instead of the three included per game. Cancel any time.

How to play
──────────────
1. Type any word into the search bar
2. See your rank and temperature (hot/warm/cold)
3. Use the feedback to narrow in on the secret word
4. Find the secret word to win

If you loved Wordle, Semantle, or any NYT word game — you'll love Hot & Cold. Use hot and cold hints to uncover a mystery word.

games.name: DOOMNUT
games.description:
DOOMNUT is a local social deduction game played on a single phone, for 4 to 8 players.

THE CONCEPT
A secret word is given to the crew. But among you hides a Virus who doesn't know the word. The Officer leads the interrogation, everyone gives a clue, and you must unmask the impostor before time runs out. Watch out: the Parasite knows a similar word and tries to spread confusion...

THE ROLES
• Officer — Leads the mission and sets the wager
• Crew — Knows the secret word, must find the Virus
• Virus — Doesn't know the word, must bluff to survive
• Parasite — Knows a similar word, spreads confusion

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pass the phone: each player secretly discovers their role and word
2. The Officer starts the timer and sets the wager
3. Everyone gives a clue in turn
4. Debate, accuse, bluff
5. Vote to eliminate the suspect

FEATURES
• 1 phone for the whole group — no need to download on every device
• 4 to 8 players
• Quick rounds (2min30 to 5min30)
• Points and wager system
• Immersive cyberpunk atmosphere
• Perfect for parties, hangouts and trips

games.name: Bead 16 - Sholo Guti
games.description:
Bead 16 - Sholo Guti brings the traditional Bengali board game to your phone — pick up beads, jump captures, and outsmart your opponent. Three classic variants in one polished app.

🎯 THREE GAMES IN ONE
• Sholo Guti (Bead 16) — the original 16-bead capture game played across South Asia for centuries
• Baro Guti (Bead 12) — faster 12-bead variant on a smaller board, same deep strategy
• Baagh Chal — asymmetric Tigers vs. Soldiers from Nepal: 4 tigers hunt, 20 soldiers trap

🤖 PLAY HOW YOU LIKE
• VS AI — three difficulty levels (Easy 🥉, Medium 🥈, Hard 🥇) with smart move evaluation
• Local multiplayer — pass-and-play on one device with a friend
• Online multiplayer — challenge real players, in-game chat, leaderboards (coming soon)

✨ DESIGNED FOR EVERY PLAYER
• Bilingual interface — English & বাংলা
• Five board themes: Classic Wood, Modern Dark, Premium Green, Royal Purple, Ocean Blue
• Tap-to-move and Drag-and-drop control schemes
• Configurable game timer (5, 10, or 15 minutes per match)
• Light & Dark mode that follows your system
• Resume saved games right where you left off
• Detailed stats — wins, losses, draws, win rate per variant

📜 LEARN AS YOU PLAY
Built-in tutorials walk you through movement, capturing, multi-jumps, and tips for every variant. New to traditional board games? You'll be capturing beads in minutes.

🏆 BUILT FOR FOCUS
• No forced sign-up — play instantly
• Lightweight under 100MB
• Offline play for AI and local modes
• No tracking inside the game; ads only at natural breakpoints

A tribute to a centuries-old folk game from Bengal, rebuilt for today's screens. Whether you grew up playing on the dirt with stones and pebbles, or you're discovering Sholo Guti for the first time, this is the home for the game on Android.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
✓ Three games, one download
✓ Tested AI that doesn't make obvious mistakes
✓ Beautiful, accessibility-friendly board themes
✓ Quiet, ad-supported model — no in-app purchases needed to play
✓ Updated regularly based on player feedback

ABOUT BEAD 16 / SHOLO GUTI
"Sholo Guti" literally means "sixteen pieces" in Bengali. Played on a Char Goti board with sixteen beads per side, the goal is simple: capture every opposing bead by jumping over it onto an empty point. Multiple captures in a single turn are allowed and rewarded. The game has roots in rural Bengal and continues to be played at family gatherings, tea stalls, and now — on your phone.

Baagh Chal ("Tiger Move") is a Nepali variant where four tigers must capture five soldiers while soldiers try to immobilize the tigers. A pure asymmetric strategy game.

PERFECT FOR:
✅ Strategy & board game lovers
✅ Players nostalgic for childhood folk games
✅ Anyone learning traditional South Asian games
✅ Couples & families wanting a quick local match
✅ Online players hunting fresh asynchronous strategy
✅ Bengali, Bangladeshi & diaspora players

PERMISSIONS
We only request what's necessary: internet for online play, ads, and notifications. No contacts, no camera, no microphone, no location reading beyond what advertising uses.

PRIVACY
Read our Privacy Policy: https://pixarlabs.com/privacy-policy/

SUPPORT & FEEDBACK
Email: support@pixarlabs.com
Found a bug? Have a feature idea? Tell us — we read every message.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: Sholo Guti, Baro Guti, and Baagh Chal are traditional folk games in the public domain. This is an independent app by Pixar Labs.

games.name: Fenster-Das Karten-Trinkspiel
games.description:
🍺 WINDOW – The Card Drinking Game
🎯 Game Objective

The players work together to correctly reveal all the cards in the "window."

They guess whether the face-down cards are higher, lower, the same, between, or outside the range of the already revealed cards.

Mistakes are penalized – correct guesses bring security or the opportunity to pass the turn.
... 🃏 Game Setup

The game is played with cards from 7 to Ace.

Each card appears exactly 4 times in the game.

The cards are laid out in a 5x5 square.

Only the edges are filled with cards; the center is empty.

At the start, two opposite corner cards are face up.

All other cards are face down.

▶ Gameplay

1️⃣ Choose a card
A player clicks on a face-down card that is directly adjacent to one or two face-up cards.
The adjacent face-up cards determine which choices are allowed.

2️⃣ Possible choices
🔹 One adjacent face-up card
The player may choose:
Higher
Lower
Equal
🔹 Two adjacent face-up cards
The player may choose:
Between (between the two cards in value)
Outside (lower than both or higher than both)
Equal (equal to one of the two cards)

3️⃣ Reveal card
The chosen card is Revealed

The game automatically checks whether the decision was correct or incorrect.

✅ Correct Decision

The card remains face up.
The player may continue playing.
🔁 After two correctly guessed cards in a row, the player may voluntarily pass to the next player.
👉 This is optional – the player can also continue playing themselves.

❌ Incorrect Decision

All connected revealed cards belonging to this turn are removed.

These cards are replaced with new face-down cards.

The other corner of the playing area remains untouched.

🍻 Drinking Rule

👉 The player must take as many sips as cards were removed.

Example:

3 connected cards are replaced → 3 sips

🔁 Cards & Probability

Removed cards are returned to the deck.
The deck is reshuffled.
This ensures:
No card appears more often than allowed.
Probabilities remain fair.

🏁 End of Round

When all cards in the window have been revealed:
The playing area is reshuffled.
A hint appears: "EX"

This means that if a player makes a mistake, they have to chug their drink.

🧠 Important Notes

A player can play in multiple areas simultaneously. Mistakes only affect the connected cards in that area. No one has to drink if they guess correctly (unfortunately 😏).

Have fun! 🍻🤯 Reveal cards in the rectangle / Guess higher - lower / Wrong sip of drink

games.name: Dread peak
games.description:
Welcome to Dread peak, a chilling survival horror experience that throws you into the depths of an unforgiving Antarctic wasteland. In this horror game, you play as a lone investigator sent to uncover the truth behind CORE’s last, ill-fated expedition. What you find buried beneath the ice is not just a collapsed research facility—but something far more terrifying. Inspired by classic analog horror and VHS-era horror, this immersive experience combines atmospheric dread, psychological tension, and creature-driven fear in ways that will haunt you long after the game ends.
Unravel CORE’s Dark Secrets
Traverse the harsh, icy terrain of Antarctica in search of what remains of the CORE expedition. This isn’t just a test of endurance—it’s a battle against madness. Every echoing footstep and shadowed corridor amplifies the creeping sense of dread. You’ll need to stay sharp, as each discovery brings you deeper into a mystery rooted in analog horror, scientific obsession, and unspeakable fear.
Whether you’re combing through frozen labs, deciphering journals stained by frostbite, or descending into dark caves carved by something inhuman, the story unfolds through a VHS-style horror aesthetic that plunges you into a surreal and unsettling world. Static-laced screens, glitchy recordings, and distorted audio give Dread peak its signature analog horror feel—an immersive style that elevates every scare.
Solve Cryptic Puzzles & Survive the Cold
Your survival depends on more than just running from the monster. You’ll need to solve challenging puzzles to unlock key areas, repair broken machinery, and piece together the wreckage of a Zeppelin that may be your only escape. These puzzles are embedded within a terrifying landscape where time is always against you, and the cold isn't your only enemy. Each piece of the puzzle is a breadcrumb in a story that weaves horror, science fiction, and psychological dread into a uniquely twisted narrative.
Relentless Creature Encounters
No horror game is complete without a monster—and in Dread peak, it’s one you’ll never forget. The creature doesn’t just hunt; it stalks. It listens, learns, and lurks. Within the echoing silence of the cave systems, your every breath may be the one that gives you away. Its grotesque form, flickering across old security monitors in VHS-quality grain, only adds to the terror. Whether you’re hiding in a narrow crevice or sprinting across a frozen chasm, you’ll feel the creature’s presence—relentless, unknowable, and nightmarish.
This is survival horror at its finest: tension, timing, and terror.
Meet the Last Survivors
Not everyone perished. As you explore, you’ll encounter broken, haunted NPCs—each clinging to sanity in their own way. Through disturbing dialogue and tragic backstories, you’ll unravel the deeper motives behind CORE’s experiments. Who is still human? Who is hiding something? Their cryptic insights, combined with analog horror-style environmental storytelling, paint a picture far worse than you imagined.
Immersive Horror, Analog-Style
Blending the aesthetics of VHS horror with the immersive gameplay of classic survival horror, Dread peak delivers an atmospheric masterpiece. Limited resources force tough choices. The ever-present cold and the unpredictability of the creature keep you on edge. And the haunting analog visuals—complete with visual distortion, screen tearing, and eerie magnetic warping—create an experience that feels pulled from an unearthed tape, lost to time. Dreadpeak Guardian Horror Game

games.name: Downfall - Offline Word Puzzle
games.description:
Downfall is a strategic offline word puzzle game and brain training challenge where finding the words is only half the challenge.

Trace letters across the grid to find words. When a word is found, its tiles are removed and everything above cascades down. Simple to learn, but the order you solve the words in changes the entire board. Choose wrong and you'll reach a dead end with no way out.

This isn't a word search or a crossword. Downfall is a letter puzzle that rewards strategy and planning over speed. Every level is a logic problem disguised as a word game.

HOW TO PLAY

Find words by tracing a path through adjacent letters, similar to Boggle or word connect games. Tiles fall when a word is cleared, shifting the grid. Find all the words to complete the level. Stuck? Use a hint or undo your last move and try a different approach.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Unlike most word games, Downfall isn't about finding as many words as possible. Every level has a specific set of words and a specific order that works. Spot the pattern, plan ahead, and clear the board. One wrong move and the whole puzzle changes.

As you progress through chapters, new tile types unlock that change the rules. Stone tiles are shared between words and take multiple clears to remove. Wildcard tiles match any letter. Each new tile type adds a layer to the strategy.

DAILY CHALLENGE

A new puzzle drops every day, harder than the standard levels. Your score is calculated based on time, undos used, hints used and how often you got trapped. Compete on the global leaderboard and see how you rank against players worldwide.

FEATURES

- Hundreds of puzzles across multiple chapters
- New tile types unlock as you progress
- Undo any move and rethink your approach
- Daily word challenge with a global leaderboard
- Fully offline, no internet or wifi required (excludes daily challenge)

The Stakes: If the bowl stays empty, your pet won't be happy.
The Ultimate Karma: The master who fails to feed the pet becomes the very thing he hunted lunch!

THE PURIFICATION RISK:
Don't let the toxic targets linger! Their Sensitive Toxins have the power to purify the evil soul of the Happy Toilet Pet. Use your fists to interrupt the Goddess’s "blessings" and keep your pet evil!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
Paradoxical Humor: A world where "saving" someone means making them too toxic to eat.
Physics of Fail: High speed ragdoll dragging and chaotic encounters.
Cheeky Satire: A game that turns common sense upside down for a trophy. Being evil is a cheeky job! Hunt targets for your Happy Toilet Pet, dodge the Toxic Goddess’s pink energy, and win the Golden Cup or get flushed! Happy Toilet Pet

games.name: IQ MAXX
games.description:
IQ MAXX is the daily IQ test + cognitive training app.

Take a 27-question multi-domain test in about 15 minutes. Get your score, percentile, and 4-domain cognitive profile. Then train daily across Pattern recognition, Numerical reasoning, Verbal ability, and Memory — and retake the full test every two weeks to see how your score moves.

WHAT'S INSIDE

— 27-question IQ test across 4 cognitive domains
— Your IQ score, percentile, and Gaussian-curve placement
— 4-domain cognitive profile: Pattern · Numerical · Verbal · Memory
— Daily training rotations to build a streak
— Bi-weekly retests to track score growth over time
— Progress charts and full session history
— Wrong-answer reviews with worked explanations

HOW IT WORKS

The test uses validated psychometric item types — Raven-style matrix reasoning, digit span, spatial sequence, verbal analogies — the same families used in clinical assessment. Your score is calibrated against the standard normal distribution, with a mean of 100 and σ of 15, using a difficulty-weighted model.

After the test, daily training keeps you sharp across all four domains. Bi-weekly retests show how your score actually moves over time.

PRIVACY

No ads. No third-party trackers. No data sold. Your test responses and training history stay on your device. Subscription state is managed by RevenueCat under an anonymous user ID. See the in-app Privacy Policy for the full breakdown.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

— Monthly: $12.99/month
— Annual: $59.99/year (saves 62% vs monthly)

Both plans unlock the full app. Cancel anytime in iPhone Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Privacy Policy: https://kaput-prepared-e8a.notion.site/IQ-MAXX-Privacy-Policy-36073fd2f03f802587a5dbc835b1dad9

Terms of Use (EULA):

games.description:
My 4-year-old wanted to play checkers on a table. I searched the App Store for a checkers game with no ads and no in-app purchases — and couldn't find one. So I decided to build it myself.

To make it more fun for a little kid, I added playful capture animations, color themes, and a silly bunny character who watches the game and reacts to what's happening on the board. I also added flexible rule settings to cover all the major checkers variants played around the world:

• English (American) checkers — short kings, forward captures only
• Russian checkers — flying kings, backward captures, promotion during chain
• Brazilian checkers — flying kings with majority capture rule
• Italian checkers — short kings, men cannot capture kings

Each rule can also be toggled individually, so you can mix and match to create your own variant.

That is the entire monetization. No coin packs, no boosters, no "watch an ad to play another hand." A single optional unlock and the daily refresh.

Free to download. Optional $0.99 unlock removes the 50-coin per-game cost. Family Sharing enabled - one purchase covers the household. The only Hearts app where the AI cheats only if you ask it to. Bao la Kiswahili - the full traditional rule set. Includes the namua opening (each player has 22 seeds in hand), the special nyumba (house) pit with taxation and safari, mandatory captures, multilap relay sowing, kichwa relay after capture, kuendelea continuation, kutakatia blocking, and the classic "more than 15 seeds" rule. Modeled on the Zanzibari rules transcribed by Alex de Voogt.

LEARNING THE GAME

Bao rewards planning many laps ahead. If you are starting out, play a few games of Kujifunza against the Beginner opponent to internalize the way multilap relays cascade and how captures relay back from a kichwa. When that feels comfortable, switch to Kiswahili to learn the namua opening and the rhythm of the nyumba.

games.name: VTT Companion
games.description:
VTT Companion is a mobile application designed to enhance your D&D5e experience with Foundry VTT while keeping the load on your device minimal.

It provides an optimised interface for accessing your character sheets, spells, and items on your phone or tablet, allowing you to stay engaged in the game without needing to switch to a desktop interface.

It relies on a Foundry VTT module, the "Companion Bridge", to connect to your game and provide real-time updates to your character sheets, and interactions with your spells and items.

The "Companion Bridge" module is installed on your Foundry VTT server. It acts as a bridge between the server and the mobile app, enabling real-time synchronisation. The module is available in both free and premium versions, offering different levels of functionality and integration with Foundry VTT.
With the free version, all connected players can view their stats, inventory, and spells as they change in Foundry. Players can also change the local state of their character (HP, spell slots, exhaustion, ...), however, it does not include the possibility to send changes to Foundry, cast spells, use items, etc.
The premium version unlocks full two-way updates, rest mechanisms, complete roll integration, items, features, and spells usage, and so much more! It also helps us continue developing, maintaining the app and adding new features.

If you're interested or want some more information, don't hesitate to visit our Patreon or the wiki page :) A Foundry VTT Mobile Companion

games.name: ChessP2P
games.description:
Chess. Offline. Anywhere.

ChessP2P is the chess app that works when nothing else does — on a plane, in a tunnel, deep in the basement, halfway up a mountain. Two iPhones pair directly over Bluetooth or peer-to-peer Wi-Fi. No internet, no accounts, no ads. Just open and play.

What's in the free tier:

- Pass-and-play — two players, one phone. Board auto-flips after each move.
- Peer-to-peer — pair two iPhones over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi with one tap.
- Full chess rules, including castling, en passant, and promotion.
- Chess clocks — 5+0, 10+0, 15+10, 30+0, or untimed.
- Draw offers, resignation, claim draw.
- Move history with replay.
- Saved games — pick up where you left off if you get disconnected.
- No accounts. No login. No tracking. No ads. No nags.

How it works:

1. Open ChessP2P on both phones.
2. One taps Host, the other taps Join. Connect over Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi.
3. Play. Moves sync instantly between devices.

That's the whole onboarding. If you've ever spent five minutes trying to play chess on a plane and watched every "offline" chess app demand a connection, this is the app you wanted.

Built for real offline.

ChessP2P uses Apple's MultipeerConnectivity — direct device-to-device. No servers. No router. No Wi-Fi network required. The two phones find each other directly, even in airplane mode (just keep Bluetooth on).

If a peer drops out, the game is saved on both sides. Reconnect and it picks up where it left off.

Free, with optional premium.

The full chess experience above is free, with no ads. A one-time premium unlock will add board and piece themes, expanded clock presets, multiple concurrent games, and post-game analysis. Pay once, unlock for life — no subscriptions. When you play a friend in a P2P session, your premium features extend to them for the duration of the game; they never have to pay to play with you.

Perfect for flights and airplane mode, subway commutes, cafés where the Wi-Fi is "ask the bartender," camping trips, festivals, and casual games between friends, parents and kids, or anyone learning the game.

Built offline, on purpose. The chess app that works when nothing else does. Pass-and-play, P2P over Bluetooth, full clocks, draw offers — no internet, no accounts, no ads. Chess. Offline. Anywhere.

games.name: Dual Knights
games.description:
In the mystical realm of Dualaria, two ancient orders of knights maintained the delicate balance between the primordial forces of fire and water. For millennia, the Flame Knights and Aqua Knights served as guardians of their respective elements, dwelling in opposing temples at the far edges of the kingdom.

Legend spoke of a catastrophic event known as the Sundering, when a powerful artifact called the Equilibrium Crystal shattered into countless sigils, scattering across the land. This crystal had once kept the elemental forces in perfect harmony, but its destruction threatened to plunge the world into chaos.

Two knights – Flame and Aqua – discovered that they shared a unique bond through the crystal's magic. When one moved, the other was compelled to move in the opposite direction, as if they were reflections in nature's grand mirror. What seemed at first like a curse revealed itself to be a blessing, for only through this connected opposition could they hope to restore balance to their realm.

Together, they embarked on a sacred quest to collect the scattered sigils. Each pair of sigils they gathered would restore a small measure of harmony to Dualaria. Their journey became known as the Mirror Quest, where every step forward by one knight required an equal step in the opposite direction by the other – a dance of fire and water, a puzzle of movement and cooperation.

The knights learned that their seemingly contrary movements were not a hindrance but a representation of the natural order itself: for every action, there must be an equal and opposite reaction. Only by embracing this fundamental truth could they hope to restore the Equilibrium Crystal and bring peace back to their troubled land.

Now, Flame and Aqua travel across Dualaria, navigating increasingly complex paths to reach their designated sigils. Their quest serves as a reminder that opposing forces need not be enemies – indeed, they are essential partners in maintaining the balance of all things. Mirror movement puzzle game

Connect the colors. Master the flow.

Tile Flow is the satisfying color-matching puzzle where you drag to link same-colored tiles, chain them together, and clear the board in a single sweep. Simple to learn. Endlessly deep to master.

HOW TO PLAY

Drag your finger across 3 or more touching tiles of the same color to form a chain. Release to clear them and score points. The longer the chain, the bigger the reward — link 10+ tiles for a massive 3× combo multiplier and watch your score soar.

THREE EXCITING MODES

Classic — Endless Progression
Start small on a 4×4 grid and grow through 5 increasingly challenging phases: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert, and Master. The board expands, the colors multiply, and locked tiles block your path. How far can you flow?

Blitz — 90-Second Race
Race against the clock! Clearing chains adds precious seconds to the timer. Every move counts — think fast, chain hard, score big.

Daily Challenge — A Fresh Puzzle Every Day
30 moves. One carefully crafted board. Return each day to protect your streak and unlock rewards. Miss a day? A Streak Shield keeps your streak alive.

Weekly Challenge — Compete Globally
Every Monday, a new puzzle drops for all players worldwide. Same board, different strategies. Submit your score and climb the global leaderboard.

FEATURES

• 6 stunning visual themes: Classic, Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Neon, and Galaxy
• Combo multiplier system — 2×, 3×, and Ultra combos for epic chains
• Flow streak bonuses for consecutive smart plays
• 6-tier rank progression: Beginner → Connector → Flow Finder → Tile Master → Chain Expert → Flow Legend
• Daily and weekly streak rewards

• Locked tiles add strategic depth in advanced phases
• 100% offline — no account required to play

games.name: Buwaya: Political Engine
games.description:
Welcome to Malacañang, Mr. / Madam President. You have six years. Don’t mess it up.

Step into the highest office in the land in this wildly strategic, deeply satirical political rogue-like engine-builder!

You have exactly two motions (action) per year to build a legacy, balance the national budget, and keep the public from ousting you. Will you be the "Grassroots Hope" who relies on the love of the masses, or "The Iron Fist" with infinite manpower but zero public trust?

Draft from a deck of 50+ Project Cards to build your political engine. Sign a BPO Tax Holiday to secure long-term funds, rush a Mega-Dam Project, or take the easy way out and accept a China Debt Trap for instant cash (just don't ask about the interest rate).

But in Philippine politics, the math isn't your only enemy. Every year, you must pass a Krisis Check—from a devastating Jeepney Tigil-Pasada to a terrifying Senate Blue Ribbon Probe. If your infrastructure, trust, or welfare tracks are too low, your administration will suffer catastrophic penalties.

And just when you think you've balanced the books? The Delubyo hits.
Face a brutal RNG chance every year of enduring typhoons, El Niño droughts, or a random MRT-3 breakdown. Do you spend your precious budget to mitigate the disaster, or take the raw hit and pray you have enough approval ratings to survive?

KEY FEATURES:

Rogue-like Engine Building: See 5 random Project Cards a year. With only 12 actions per game, every single click matters. Can't afford the EDSA Subway? Sell it to the market for a free action to fund your survival!

Dual-Threat System: Anticipate the yearly Krisis thresholds, but stay paranoid about the unpredictable chance of a Delubyo disaster.

Reiner Knizia-Style Scoring: A thriving economy means nothing if your healthcare system is zero. Your final score is heavily penalized by your lowest performing track. You must balance Tibay (Infrastructure), Ginhawa (Welfare), and Tiwala (Trust) to win.

Mandates: Start your run as "The Unity Successor", "The Balimbing Coalition", "The People Power Icon" and many more. Every mandate completely changes your starting economy and strategy.

The Compendium: Track your progress! Play to unlock the hidden silhouettes of all 50 Project Cards, Delubyos, and Crises in your interactive compendium.

Card counting won’t save you from a super typhoon, and money can't buy your way out of a Missing Health Funds scandal.

Do you have the strategic genius to build a lasting legacy, or will you be ousted before your term ends? Take the oath and find out. Buwaya: Political Engine

games.name: Book, please
games.description:
BookPlease is not about “tap and get a reward.” It is about the morning when there is already a line at the door, the collection is short on a popular genre, a reader’s card is overdue, and the display shipment is still on its way. You are the owner of a private library: you are behind the counter yourself, and the rules are fair — but carelessness gets expensive.

Serve visitors at the counter: check books out, extend loans, refuse requests with a reason — and every action is checked against the database and the collection. Make a mistake, and you get a fine, an entry in the error log, and a hit to trust and reputation. Do everything by the book, and the cash register comes alive while readers keep coming back.

Manage your readers and your collection: copies on the shelf, statuses, repairs, courier returns, and batches “in transit.” Order books from the online store, catch shortages by genre, handle online reservations, and do not let down the readers who arrive on the promised dates. At the bank, you have a credit line, required payments, and a deposit: without money, you cannot expand; without discipline, you will hit the ceiling.

Each in-game day can begin with a daily goal: a calm plan, a focus on accuracy, or a risky challenge with a reward — depending on your style and the state of your cash flow. Hire staff, pay salaries, and grow their skills. Unlock achievements and move toward the big goal: buying out the premises. It is not decoration, but a financial and reputational peak.

A warm paper-like interface, an error log with no surprises, and rules you can read inside the game. Want to calmly catalogue the collection? You can. Want to squeeze everything out of a risky day? You can do that too. The main thing is simple: do not promise a reader what is not in the collection.

BookPlease is a library as a job: attentive, a little strict, and deeply satisfying when everything adds up at the end of the day.

games.name: Prior: Calibration Trainer
games.description:
Most people think they're better at predicting the future than they actually are. A perfect predictor knows the quality of their predictions, and you can rely on their 80% forecasts to be right exactly 80% of the time. This skill is called calibration. 
THE ENGINE
An infinite question bank spanning science, economics, technology, history, sports, and culture. For every question, you don't just answer true or false; you state how confident you are. That confidence is what Prior measures.
Binary mode tests your true/false predictions with a confidence slider. Continuous mode (Prior Pro) asks you to estimate ranges - the harder, more revealing challenge that separates calibrated thinkers from lucky guessers.
THE CALIBRATION CURVE
Your calibration curve is the most honest thing about you. It shows whether the things you believe with 80% confidence actually happen 80% of the time. Most people are overconfident at high confidence levels - their curve bends away from perfect. Prior makes that visible.
THE JOURNAL
Track your real-world predictions - markets, elections, sports, personal decisions. Set a resolution date, state your confidence, come back when the answer is known. Your journal builds a permanent record of your forecasting history, scored alongside your engine training.
THE LEADERBOARD
Compete globally against other forecasters ranked by Brier score.
PRIOR PRO
Unlimited continuous (range estimate) questions, full calibration curve with domain breakdown, Brier trend over time, confidence distribution analysis, unlimited journal predictions, and a Pro badge on the global leaderboard.
Free users get unlimited binary training, basic stats, and up to 10 active journal predictions.
PRIVACY
No advertising. No data sold. Optional account for leaderboard access - anonymous training requires no sign-in.

games.name: Chance Knight
games.description:
Welcome to Chance Knight. This application is a mini game designed for those who want to practice speed arithmetic checks and test their mental calculation abilities.

Gameplay mechanics and process:
The main task in the game is to evaluate mathematical equations under time pressure. Each round presents you with a simple addition or subtraction problem that includes a suggested total result. Your goal is to decide whether the equality is mathematically correct or incorrect before the timer reaches zero.

Rules of the game:
You start each session with a time limit of two seconds per question. To give your answer you must tap the True button if you believe the equation is correct or tap the False button if it is wrong. Accuracy is key because providing one wrong answer or failing to answer before time runs out will immediately end your current run.

Increasing challenge:
The game features a dynamic difficulty system. Every correct decision you make slightly shortens the time limit for the subsequent question. This creates a challenging environment where you must maintain focus and process information faster as you progress. The primary goal is to chain as many correct decisions as possible while the timer keeps getting tighter.

Tracking your progress:
During the game you can monitor your current score and the remaining time on the screen. Once a run is finished, the application displays a summary screen showing exactly how many answers you cleared during that session. From this screen you can choose to use the Try again button to start a new attempt or return to the main menu.

Visual and interface:
The game features a clear interface with prominent buttons for comfortable interaction. The background elements include thematic illustrations with palm trees and treasure chests which accompany the mathematical tasks. Chance Knight offers a simple way to spend time while engaging your brain in quick calculation exercises. Test your speed arithmetic skills and improve your reaction in Chance Knight.

games.name: Fortune Hunter
games.description:
Welcome to Fortune Hunter. This application is a mini game designed to test your reaction time and visual attention through a simple grid interface.

What you do in the game:
The gameplay takes place on a three by three grid. During the round tiles light up in a random order. Most of these pulses are blue and stay visible for a short moment. Your task is to tap these blue tiles while they glow to register a successful hit. However, you must remain observant because sometimes a tile stays red for two full seconds. You should never tap a red tile as this is a core rule of the game.

Round flow and mechanics:
Each session runs on a timer that counts down. A round ends naturally when the clock reaches zero. If you successfully survive the countdown you will automatically move to the second screen to see your results. Please note that if you accidentally tap a red tile, the round stops immediately and you advance to the results screen early.

Tracking your results:
The second screen provides a clear summary of your performance. It displays the number of successful blue taps you earned in the most recent round. Additionally, the app keeps track of your running total of successful taps across every finished round you have played on your device.

Quick rules to remember:

Tap blue pulses before they fade away.

Leave red pulses alone until they disappear from the grid.

Survive the full countdown or accept an early stop if a red tile is touched.

Use the Play again button for another round or return to the main menu when you are done.

Fortune Hunter offers a focused experience where staying calm and reading the rhythm of the pulses helps you maintain a high success rate. Test your attention and reaction speed by catching blue pulses in Fortune Hunter

games.name: Treasure Map
games.description:
Welcome to Treasure Map. This application features a Ten second Tap Sprint mini game designed to test your speed and consistency through a simple interactive interface.

The primary objective of the game is to tap the teal circle as many times as possible during a live ten second countdown. Every legal tap you perform increases your score in real time. Your goal is to achieve the highest tap count before the timer reaches zero.

The application process consists of several stages. The first screen streams the active countdown, your running total of taps, and the large tap target. You must focus on tapping only the designated circle while the timer remains above 0 seconds. Each tap is counted exactly once throughout the duration of the sprint.

When the time expires, the app automatically forwards you to the results dashboard. This summary screen allows you to review your performance by displaying the following data points:

Taps achieved during the current round.

Your clicks per second (CPS) pace, calculated as total taps divided by ten.

Your saved personal record for total taps.

Your all time best clicks per second (CPS) rate.

After reviewing your summary, you can choose to use the Play again button to start a new sprint and chase a stronger record. Alternatively, you can close the summary to return to the main menu. Treasure Map provides a straightforward way to track and improve your tapping speed over time. Test your speed in Treasure Map by tapping the target during a 10 second sprint

Get ready for a colorful grid-based puzzle challenge where every move matters! In Rope Cut Jam, ropes twist across the board like snakes, cutters slide in straight lines, and your goal is to find the perfect order to cut every rope.

Each level is filled with colorful ropes, sharp cutters, clever blockers, and tricky mechanics. Tap a cutter, send it forward, and watch it move across the grid. But be careful — cutters can only cut ropes that match their own color. If they hit the wrong rope, another cutter, or an obstacle, they bounce back!

Plan your moves, clear the path, and solve each rope-cutting puzzle before the board gets too crowded.

How to Play

Cutters move straight until they hit something

When a rope is cut, all of its connected points disappear
Wrong-color ropes block the cutter and make it return

Clear all ropes to complete the level
Puzzle Elements

As you progress, new mechanics make every level more strategic:

Hidden Ropes

Mirror
Mirrors change the way cutters move and create more complex puzzle paths.

Pole
Poles block the board and force you to think around them.

Stacked Cutters

Lock & Keys
Find the right keys to unlock blocked ropes, cutters, or paths.

Boosters

Hint
Get a helpful clue when you are stuck.

Scissors
Cut through the puzzle with a direct solution tool when the board gets tricky.

Simple tap controls
Color-matching strategy
Satisfying rope-cut animations
Grid-based levels with clever move ordering
Fun blockers, locks, mirrors, and hidden elements
Easy to learn, hard to master
Relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle experience

games.name: Warrior Fortune
games.description:
Warrior Fortune presents a precision timing challenge where you test your accuracy against a growing target. The main goal of the application is to stop a transparent disc exactly when its edge meets a fixed outline.

How it works:
You will see a calm timing ring on the playing field. A transparent disc grows from the center of this ring. You must tap the screen at the exact moment the edge of the growing disc meets the inner line of the ring. Success depends on tapping not too early and not too late.

session flow:

Each game session consists of five timed pulses played back to back.

Every tap is scored on a scale from 0% to 100% based on how close your stop was to the ideal ring match.

If a pulse finishes before you manage to tap the screen that specific round scores 0%.

After the completion of the fifth pulse you receive your final results.

Results and tracking:
The session results screen displays your average accuracy for the run a combined score and your best average recorded so far. Warrior Fortune automatically tracks your personal best results to help you monitor your performance improvements.

Tips:

Watch the HUD timer during play as it mirrors the remaining stretch time for the current pulse.

Stay relaxed while playing because the ring maintains a steady speed throughout a single session. Warrior Fortune is a precision ring challenge to stop a disc on the outline.

games.description:
Mountain Treasure is a two screen reaction mini game designed to measure how fast you can respond to visual cues. It provides a straightforward challenge for anyone looking to test their focus and speed.

How to play:
The first screen is the reaction test itself. It starts with a random delay while the app shows a Waiting status. Your goal is to wait for the play area to flash green then tap the screen as fast as you can.

Rules of the game:

If you tap too early the round fails and you must tap again to retry the test.

Tapping exactly when the screen turns green records your reaction time in milliseconds.

The second screen displays your results including your last recorded time and your best time ever.

Scoring system:
Reaction time is measured from the exact moment the screen turns green until your tap is registered. A smaller number represents a faster reaction and is considered better. Your best score is always your lowest recorded time.

Tips for success:
Hold your phone steady and focus on the center of the screen to minimize your response time.

Mountain Treasure features a clean interface with a mountain landscape and a treasure chest theme. You can restart the test at any time by selecting Play again or return to the main menu using the on screen buttons. Mountain Treasure is a quick reaction mini game to measure your speed.

Petrosian avoids weaknesses at all costs and neutralises your plans before you form them. Tal sacrifices material for complications, trusting chaos over calculation. ELO RATING SYSTEM

HISTORICAL CONTEXT
Each legend comes with their era, playing style, and Elo equivalent — giving you a window into 500 years of chess history, from Ruy López in 16th-century Spain to Alekhine's combinations in the 1930s.

CLEAN, FOCUSED EXPERIENCE
No ads. No distractions. Just you and the board.

Mills · Nine Men's Morris — the most modern and content-rich version of the millennia-old strategy classic. Also known as "Mill", "Cowboy Checkers", "Merrills" and "Nine Man Morris". Play offline, ad-free, with stunning themes and a world-class AI.

• 100 difficulty levels: Minimax + alpha-beta + transposition table + iterative deepening. Crushing for veterans, gentle for beginners.

• Haptic feedback and synthesized sound effects.

GAME RULES
1. Placement: Each player places 9 stones in turn.
2. Mill: Aligning three stones lets you remove an opponent's piece.
3. Movement: Once all stones are placed, slide along lines to adjacent empty points.
4. Flying: When down to 3 pieces, fly to any empty point.
5. Winning: Reduce the opponent to 2 pieces or block all moves.

games.name: ChessMonsters

games.description:
Does your child love games and you want to introduce them to chess in a playful way? Monster Chess does exactly that – with colorful monster pieces, simple rules, and an AI that adapts to your child's skill level.
LEARN CHESS WITHOUT FRUSTRATION
Chess can feel intimidating. Monster Chess solves that in the simplest way: the pieces aren't silent wooden blocks, but lively monster characters with personality. Kids instantly understand who's on their team and who's the opponent – and almost start playing on their own.
FOUR DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Baby Monster: The dark team plays intentionally badly. Kids win almost every time and build confidence.
Sleepy Dragon: Random moves, very easy. Perfect for practicing the basic rules.
Angry Wolf: The monster starts capturing pieces. A real challenge for kids with some experience.
Evil Wizard: Simple strategy for kids who already know their way around the board.
100% SAFE FOR KIDS
No ads. No internet. No account. No tracking. No in-app purchases. Monster Chess runs entirely on the device – no outside connections. The parent area is protected by a simple math problem so kids can't accidentally change settings.
FOR PARENTS
As a parent you know: the best games are the ones where kids don't even realize they're learning. Monster Chess teaches your child all the basic rules of chess – pawns, knights, bishops, rooks, queens, kings – without learning pressure and without screen-time guilt.
Chess builds logical thinking, focus, and patience. And with Monster Chess, it's actually fun.
Buy once. No subscription. Play forever. Learn chess the fun way – with monster pieces, no ads, no internet, no subscription. Buy once, play forever. Chess for Kids Ages 6 and Up
